4893.label: Deuteronomy 1:1
4893.text: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel in the region of the Jordan in the wilderness, on the desert plains in front of Suph, between Paʹran and Toʹphel and Laʹban and Ha·zeʹroth and Diʹza·hab,

4894.label: Deuteronomy 1:2
4894.text: it being eleven days from Hoʹreb by the way of Mount Seʹir to Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a.

4895.label: Deuteronomy 1:3
4895.text: And it came about that in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month, Moses spoke to the sons of Israel according to all that Jehovah had commanded him for them,

4896.label: Deuteronomy 1:4
4896.text: after his defeating Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites, who was dwelling in Heshʹbon, and Og the king of Baʹshan, who was dwelling in Ashʹta·roth, in Edʹre·i.

4897.label: Deuteronomy 1:5
4897.text: In the region of the Jordan in the land of Moʹab Moses undertook to explain this law, saying:

4898.label: Deuteronomy 1:6
4898.text: “Jehovah our God spoke to us in Hoʹreb, saying, ‘YOU have dwelt long enough in this mountainous region.

4899.label: Deuteronomy 1:7
4899.text: Turn and set out on YOUR way and go into the mountainous region of the Amʹor·ites and to all their neighbors in the Arʹa·bah, the mountainous region and the She·pheʹlah and the Negʹeb and the seacoast, the land of the Caʹnaan·ites, and Lebʹa·non, up to the great river, the river Eu·phraʹtes.

4900.label: Deuteronomy 1:8
4900.text: See, I do put the land before YOU people. Go in and take possession of the land about which Jehovah swore to YOUR fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, to give it to them and their seed after them.’

4901.label: Deuteronomy 1:9
4901.text: “And I proceeded to say this to YOU at that particular time, ‘I am not able by myself to carry YOU.

4902.label: Deuteronomy 1:10
4902.text: Jehovah YOUR God has multiplied YOU, and here YOU are today like the stars of the heavens for multitude.

4903.label: Deuteronomy 1:11
4903.text: May Jehovah the God of YOUR forefathers increase YOU a thousand times as many as YOU are, and may he bless YOU just as he has promised YOU.

4904.label: Deuteronomy 1:12
4904.text: How can I carry by myself the burden of YOU and the load of YOU and YOUR quarreling?

4905.label: Deuteronomy 1:13
4905.text: Get wise and discreet and experienced men of YOUR tribes, that I may set them as heads over YOU.’

4906.label: Deuteronomy 1:14
4906.text: At that YOU answered me and said, ‘The thing you have spoken for us to do is good.’

4907.label: Deuteronomy 1:15
4907.text: So I took the heads of YOUR tribes, men wise and experienced, and put them as heads over YOU, chiefs of thousands and chiefs of hundreds and chiefs of fifties and chiefs of tens and officers of YOUR tribes.

4908.label: Deuteronomy 1:16
4908.text: “And I went on to command YOUR judges at that particular time, saying, ‘When having a hearing between YOUR brothers, YOU must judge with righteousness between a man and his brother or his alien resident.

4909.label: Deuteronomy 1:17
4909.text: YOU must not be partial in judgment. YOU should hear the little one the same as the great one. YOU must not become frightened because of a man, for the judgment belongs to God; and the case that is too hard for YOU, YOU should present to me, and I must hear it.’

4910.label: Deuteronomy 1:18
4910.text: And I proceeded to command YOU at that particular time all the things that YOU should do.

4911.label: Deuteronomy 1:19
4911.text: “Then we pulled away from Hoʹreb and went marching through all that great and fear-inspiring wilderness, which YOU have seen, by the way of the mountainous region of the Amʹor·ites, just as Jehovah our God had commanded us; and we eventually came to Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a.

4912.label: Deuteronomy 1:20
4912.text: I now said to YOU, ‘YOU have come to the mountainous region of the Amʹor·ites, which Jehovah our God is giving to us.

4913.label: Deuteronomy 1:21
4913.text: See, Jehovah your God has abandoned the land to you. Go up, take possession, just as Jehovah the God of your forefathers has spoken to you. Do not be afraid, nor be terrified.’

4914.label: Deuteronomy 1:22
4914.text: “However, all of YOU came near to me and said, ‘Do let us send men ahead of us that they may search out the land for us and bring us back word concerning the way by which we should go up and the cities to which we will come.’

4915.label: Deuteronomy 1:23
4915.text: Well, the thing proved to be good in my eyes, so that I took twelve men of YOURS, one for each tribe.

4916.label: Deuteronomy 1:24
4916.text: Then they turned and went up into the mountainous region and got as far as the torrent valley of Eshʹcol and went spying on it.

4917.label: Deuteronomy 1:25
4917.text: And they proceeded to take some of the fruitage of the land in their hand and to bring it down to us, and they came bringing us back word and saying, ‘The land that Jehovah our God is giving us is good.’

4918.label: Deuteronomy 1:26
4918.text: But YOU did not wish to go up, and YOU began to behave rebelliously against the order of Jehovah YOUR God.

4919.label: Deuteronomy 1:27
4919.text: And YOU kept grumbling in YOUR tents and saying, ‘It was because Jehovah hated us that he brought us out of the land of Egypt to give us into the hand of the Amʹor·ites, to annihilate us.

4920.label: Deuteronomy 1:28
4920.text: Where are we going up? Our brothers have caused our heart to melt, saying: “A people greater and taller than we are, cities great and fortified to the heavens and also the sons of the Anʹa·kim we saw there.”’

4921.label: Deuteronomy 1:29
4921.text: “So I said to YOU, ‘YOU must not suffer a shock or be afraid because of them.

4922.label: Deuteronomy 1:30
4922.text: Jehovah YOUR God is the one going before YOU. He will fight for YOU according to all that he did with YOU in Egypt under YOUR own eyes,

4923.label: Deuteronomy 1:31
4923.text: and in the wilderness, where you saw how Jehovah your God carried you just as a man carries his son, in all the way that YOU walked until YOUR coming to this place.’

4924.label: Deuteronomy 1:32
4924.text: But despite this word YOU were not putting faith in Jehovah YOUR God,

4925.label: Deuteronomy 1:33
4925.text: who was going before YOU in the way to spy out for YOU a place for YOU to camp, by fire at night for YOU to see by what way YOU should walk and by a cloud in daytime.

4926.label: Deuteronomy 1:34
4926.text: “All the while Jehovah heard the voice of YOUR words. So he became indignant and swore, saying,

4927.label: Deuteronomy 1:35
4927.text: ‘Not one among these men of this evil generation will see the good land that I swore to give to YOUR fathers,

4928.label: Deuteronomy 1:36
4928.text: except Caʹleb the son of Je·phunʹneh. He will see it, and to him and to his sons I shall give the land upon which he trod, by reason of the fact that he has followed Jehovah fully.

4929.label: Deuteronomy 1:37
4929.text: (Even against me Jehovah got incensed on YOUR account, saying, ‘You too will not go in there.

4930.label: Deuteronomy 1:38
4930.text: Joshua the son of Nun, who is standing before you, is the one who will go in there.’ Him he has made strong, because he will cause Israel to inherit it.)

4931.label: Deuteronomy 1:39
4931.text: As for YOUR little ones of whom YOU said: “Plunder they will become!” and YOUR sons who today do not know good or bad, these will go in there, and to them I shall give it, and they will take possession of it.

4932.label: Deuteronomy 1:40
4932.text: As for YOU yourselves, change your direction and pull away for the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea.’

4933.label: Deuteronomy 1:41
4933.text: “At this YOU answered and said to me, ‘We have sinned against Jehovah. We—we shall go up and fight in accord with all that Jehovah our God has commanded us!’ So YOU girded on, each one, his weapons of war and regarded it as easy to go up into the mountain.

4934.label: Deuteronomy 1:42
4934.text: But Jehovah said to me, ‘Say to them: “YOU must not go up and fight, because I am not in YOUR midst; that YOU may not be defeated before YOUR enemies.”’

4935.label: Deuteronomy 1:43
4935.text: So I spoke to YOU, and YOU did not listen but began to behave rebelliously against Jehovah’s order and to get all heated up, and you tried to go up into the mountain.

4936.label: Deuteronomy 1:44
4936.text: Then the Amʹor·ites who were dwelling in that mountain came out to meet YOU and went chasing YOU, just as bees do, and scattering YOU in Seʹir as far as Horʹmah.

4937.label: Deuteronomy 1:45
4937.text: After that YOU returned and began to weep before Jehovah, but Jehovah did not listen to YOUR voice, neither did he give ear to YOU.

4938.label: Deuteronomy 1:46
4938.text: So YOU kept dwelling in Kaʹdesh many days, as many days as YOU did dwell there.

4939.label: Deuteronomy 2:1
4939.text: “Then we turned and pulled away for the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea, just as Jehovah had spoken to me; and we were many days in going around Mount Seʹir.

4940.label: Deuteronomy 2:2
4940.text: Finally Jehovah said this to me,

4941.label: Deuteronomy 2:3
4941.text: ‘YOU have gone around this mountain long enough. Change YOUR direction to the north.

4942.label: Deuteronomy 2:4
4942.text: And command the people, saying: “YOU are passing along by the border of YOUR brothers, the sons of Eʹsau, who are dwelling in Seʹir; and they will be afraid because of YOU, and YOU must be very careful.

4943.label: Deuteronomy 2:5
4943.text: Do not engage in strife with them, because I shall not give YOU of their land so much as the width of the sole of the foot; because I have given Mount Seʹir to Eʹsau as a holding.

4944.label: Deuteronomy 2:6
4944.text: What food YOU may buy from them for money, YOU must eat; and also what water YOU may purchase from them for money, YOU must drink.

4945.label: Deuteronomy 2:7
4945.text: For Jehovah your God has blessed you in every deed of your hand. He well knows of your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years Jehovah your God has been with you. You have not lacked a thing.”’

4946.label: Deuteronomy 2:8
4946.text: So we passed on away from our brothers, the sons of Eʹsau, who are dwelling in Seʹir, from the way of the Arʹa·bah, from Eʹlath and from Eʹzi·on-geʹber. “Next we turned and passed on by the way of the wilderness of Moʹab.

4947.label: Deuteronomy 2:9
4947.text: Jehovah then said to me, ‘Do not molest Moʹab or engage in war with them, because I shall not give you any of his land as a holding, for to the sons of Lot I have given Ar as a holding.

4948.label: Deuteronomy 2:10
4948.text: (The Eʹmim dwelt in it in former times, a people great and numerous and tall like the Anʹa·kim.

4949.label: Deuteronomy 2:11
4949.text: As for the Rephʹa·im, they also were considered like the Anʹa·kim, and the Moʹab·ites used to call them Eʹmim.

4950.label: Deuteronomy 2:12
4950.text: And the Horʹites dwelt in Seʹir in former times, and the sons of Eʹsau proceeded to dispossess them and to annihilate them from before them and to dwell in their place, just the same as Israel must do to the land that is his holding, which Jehovah will certainly give to them.)

4951.label: Deuteronomy 2:13
4951.text: At this time rise and make YOUR way across the torrent valley of Zeʹred.’ Accordingly we went crossing the torrent valley of Zeʹred.

4952.label: Deuteronomy 2:14
4952.text: And the days that we walked from Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a until we crossed the torrent valley of Zeʹred were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war had come to their end from the midst of the camp, just as Jehovah had sworn to them.

4953.label: Deuteronomy 2:15
4953.text: And the hand of Jehovah also proved to be upon them to disquiet them out of the midst of the camp, until they came to their end.

4954.label: Deuteronomy 2:16
4954.text: “And it came about that as soon as all the men of war had finished dying off from the midst of the people,

4955.label: Deuteronomy 2:17
4955.text: Jehovah spoke further to me, saying,

4956.label: Deuteronomy 2:18
4956.text: ‘You are passing today by the territory of Moʹab, that is, Ar,

4957.label: Deuteronomy 2:19
4957.text: and you must get close in front of the sons of Amʹmon. Do not molest them or engage in strife with them, because I shall not give you any of the land of the sons of Amʹmon as a holding, for it is to the sons of Lot that I have given it as a holding.

4958.label: Deuteronomy 2:20
4958.text: As the land of the Rephʹa·im it also used to be considered. (The Rephʹa·im dwelt in it in former times, and the Amʹmon·ites used to call them Zam·zumʹmim.

4959.label: Deuteronomy 2:21
4959.text: They were a great and numerous and tall people like the Anʹa·kim; and Jehovah went annihilating them from before them, that they might dispossess them and dwell in their place;

4960.label: Deuteronomy 2:22
4960.text: just the same as he did for the sons of Eʹsau, who are dwelling in Seʹir, when he annihilated the Horʹites from before them, that they might dispossess them and dwell in their place until this day.

4961.label: Deuteronomy 2:23
4961.text: As for the Avʹvim, who were dwelling in settlements as far as Gaʹza, the Caphʹto·rim, who came out from Caphʹtor, annihilated them, that they might dwell in their place.)

4962.label: Deuteronomy 2:24
4962.text: “‘GET up, pull away and cross the torrent valley of Arʹnon. See, I have given into your hand Siʹhon the king of Heshʹbon, the Amʹor·ite. So start to take possession of his land, and engage in war with him.

4963.label: Deuteronomy 2:25
4963.text: This day I shall start to put the dread of you and the fear of you before the peoples beneath all the heavens, who will hear the report about you; and they will indeed be agitated and have pains like those of childbirth because of you.’

4964.label: Deuteronomy 2:26
4964.text: “Then I sent messengers from the wilderness of Kedʹe·moth to Siʹhon the king of Heshʹbon with words of peace, saying,

4965.label: Deuteronomy 2:27
4965.text: ‘Let me pass through your land. Only on the road I shall walk. I shall not turn to the right or to the left.

4966.label: Deuteronomy 2:28
4966.text: What food you will sell me for money, I must eat; and what water you will give me for money, I must drink. Only let me pass through on my feet,

4967.label: Deuteronomy 2:29
4967.text: just the same as the sons of Eʹsau dwelling in Seʹir and the Moʹab·ites dwelling in Ar did to me, until I shall pass over the Jordan into the land that Jehovah our God is giving to us.’

4968.label: Deuteronomy 2:30
4968.text: And Siʹhon the king of Heshʹbon did not let us pass through him, because Jehovah your God had let his spirit become obstinate and his heart become hard, in order to give him into your hand just as at this day.

4969.label: Deuteronomy 2:31
4969.text: “At this Jehovah said to me, ‘See, I have started to abandon Siʹhon and his land to you. Start to take possession of his land.’

4970.label: Deuteronomy 2:32
4970.text: When Siʹhon came on out, he and all his people, to meet us in battle at Jaʹhaz,

4971.label: Deuteronomy 2:33
4971.text: then Jehovah our God abandoned him to us, so that we defeated him and his sons and all his people.

4972.label: Deuteronomy 2:34
4972.text: And we went capturing all his cities at that particular time and devoting every city to destruction, men and women and little children. We left no survivor.

4973.label: Deuteronomy 2:35
4973.text: Only the domestic animals did we take as plunder for ourselves, together with the spoil of the cities that we had captured.

4974.label: Deuteronomy 2:36
4974.text: From A·roʹer, which is by the bank of the torrent valley of Arʹnon, and the city that is in the torrent valley, as far as Gilʹe·ad, there proved to be no town that was too high up for us. Jehovah our God abandoned them all to us.

4975.label: Deuteronomy 2:37
4975.text: Only you did not go near the land of the sons of Amʹmon, the whole bank of the torrent valley of Jabʹbok, nor the cities of the mountainous region, nor anything about which Jehovah our God had given command.

4976.label: Deuteronomy 3:1
4976.text: “Then we turned and went up by the way of Baʹshan. At this Og the king of Baʹshan came on out, he and all his people, to meet us in battle at Edʹre·i.

4977.label: Deuteronomy 3:2
4977.text: So Jehovah said to me, ‘Do not be afraid of him, for I shall certainly give him and all his people and his land into your hand; and you must do to him just as you did to Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites, who was dwelling in Heshʹbon.’

4978.label: Deuteronomy 3:3
4978.text: Accordingly Jehovah our God gave into our hand also Og the king of Baʹshan and all his people, and we kept striking him until he had no survivor remaining.

4979.label: Deuteronomy 3:4
4979.text: And we went capturing all his cities at that particular time. There proved to be no town that we did not take from them, sixty cities, all the region of Arʹgob, the kingdom of Og in Baʹshan.

4980.label: Deuteronomy 3:5
4980.text: All these were cities fortified with a high wall, doors and bar, aside from very many rural towns.

4981.label: Deuteronomy 3:6
4981.text: However, we devoted them to destruction, just as we had done to Siʹhon the king of Heshʹbon, in devoting every city to destruction, men, women and little children.

4982.label: Deuteronomy 3:7
4982.text: And all the domestic animals and the spoil of the cities we took as plunder for ourselves.

4983.label: Deuteronomy 3:8
4983.text: “And we proceeded to take at that particular time the land from the hand of the two kings of the Amʹor·ites who were in the region of the Jordan, from the torrent valley of Arʹnon as far as Mount Herʹmon;

4984.label: Deuteronomy 3:9
4984.text: (the Si·doʹni·ans used to call Herʹmon Sirʹi·on, and the Amʹor·ites used to call it Seʹnir,)

4985.label: Deuteronomy 3:10
4985.text: all the cities of the tableland and all Gilʹe·ad and all Baʹshan as far as Salʹe·cah and Edʹre·i, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Baʹshan.

4986.label: Deuteronomy 3:11
4986.text: For only Og the king of Baʹshan remained of what was left of the Rephʹa·im. Look! His bier was a bier of iron. Is it not in Rabʹbah of the sons of Amʹmon? Nine cubits is its length, and four cubits its width, by the cubit of a man.

4987.label: Deuteronomy 3:12
4987.text: And we took possession of this land at that particular time; from A·roʹer, which is by the torrent valley of Arʹnon, and half of the mountainous region of Gilʹe·ad, and its cities I have given to the Reuʹben·ites and the Gadʹites.

4988.label: Deuteronomy 3:13
4988.text: And the rest of Gilʹe·ad and all Baʹshan of the kingdom of Og I have given to the half tribe of Ma·nasʹseh. All the region of Arʹgob of all Baʹshan, is it not called the land of the Rephʹa·im?

4989.label: Deuteronomy 3:14
4989.text: “Jaʹir the son of Ma·nasʹseh took all the region of Arʹgob as far as the boundary of the Geshʹur·ites and the Ma·acʹa·thites, and he proceeded to call those villages of Baʹshan by his own name, Havʹvoth-jaʹir, to this day.

4990.label: Deuteronomy 3:15
4990.text: And to Maʹchir I have given Gilʹe·ad.

4991.label: Deuteronomy 3:16
4991.text: And to the Reuʹben·ites and the Gadʹites I have given from Gilʹe·ad to the torrent valley of Arʹnon, the middle of the torrent valley being a boundary, and as far as Jabʹbok, the torrent valley that is the boundary of the sons of Amʹmon;

4992.label: Deuteronomy 3:17
4992.text: and the Arʹa·bah and the Jordan and the border, from Chinʹne·reth to the sea of the Arʹa·bah, the Salt Sea, at the base of the slopes of Pisʹgah toward the sunrising.

4993.label: Deuteronomy 3:18
4993.text: “So I commanded YOU men at that particular time, saying, ‘Jehovah YOUR God has given YOU this land to take possession of it. YOU will pass over, equipped, before YOUR brothers, the sons of Israel, all the valiant men.

4994.label: Deuteronomy 3:19
4994.text: Only YOUR wives and YOUR little ones and YOUR livestock (I well know that YOU have a great deal of livestock) will continue dwelling in YOUR cities that I have given YOU,

4995.label: Deuteronomy 3:20
4995.text: until Jehovah gives YOUR brothers rest, as well as YOU, and they also have taken possession of the land that Jehovah YOUR God is giving them across the Jordan; after which YOU must come back, each one to his holding that I have given YOU.’

4996.label: Deuteronomy 3:21
4996.text: “And I commanded Joshua at that particular time, saying, ‘Your eyes are seeing all that Jehovah YOUR God has done to these two kings. The same way Jehovah will do to all the kingdoms to which you are passing over there.

4997.label: Deuteronomy 3:22
4997.text: YOU men must not be afraid of them, for Jehovah YOUR God is the One fighting for YOU.’

4998.label: Deuteronomy 3:23
4998.text: “And I proceeded to implore favor from Jehovah at that particular time, saying,

4999.label: Deuteronomy 3:24
4999.text: ‘O Sovereign Lord Jehovah, you yourself have started to make your servant see your greatness and your strong arm, for who is a god in the heavens or on the earth that does deeds like yours and mighty performances like yours?

5000.label: Deuteronomy 3:25
5000.text: Let me pass over, please, and see the good land that is across the Jordan, this good mountainous region and Lebʹa·non.’

5001.label: Deuteronomy 3:26
5001.text: And Jehovah continued to be furious against me on YOUR account and did not listen to me; but Jehovah said to me, ‘That is enough of you! Never speak to me further on this matter.

5002.label: Deuteronomy 3:27
5002.text: Go up to the top of Pisʹgah and raise your eyes to the west and north and south and east and see with your eyes, for you will not pass over this Jordan.

5003.label: Deuteronomy 3:28
5003.text: And commission Joshua and encourage him and strengthen him, because he is the one to pass over before this people and he is the one to cause them to inherit the land that you will see.’

5004.label: Deuteronomy 3:29
5004.text: All this while we were dwelling in the valley in front of Beth-peʹor.

5005.label: Deuteronomy 4:1
5005.text: “And now, O Israel, listen to the regulations and the judicial decisions that I am teaching YOU to do, in order that YOU may live and may indeed go in and take possession of the land that Jehovah the God of YOUR forefathers is giving YOU.

5006.label: Deuteronomy 4:2
5006.text: YOU must not add to the word that I am commanding YOU, neither must YOU take away from it, so as to keep the commandments of Jehovah YOUR God that I am commanding YOU.

5007.label: Deuteronomy 4:3
5007.text: “YOUR own eyes are the ones that saw what Jehovah did in the case of the Baʹal of Peʹor, that every man who walked after the Baʹal of Peʹor was the one whom Jehovah your God annihilated from your midst.

5008.label: Deuteronomy 4:4
5008.text: But YOU who are cleaving to Jehovah YOUR God are all of YOU alive today.

5009.label: Deuteronomy 4:5
5009.text: See, I have taught YOU regulations and judicial decisions, just as Jehovah my God has commanded me, for YOU to do that way in the midst of the land to which YOU are going to take possession of it.

5010.label: Deuteronomy 4:6
5010.text: And YOU must keep and do them, because this is wisdom on YOUR part and understanding on YOUR part before the eyes of the peoples who will hear of all these regulations, and they will certainly say, ‘This great nation is undoubtedly a wise and understanding people.’

5011.label: Deuteronomy 4:7
5011.text: For what great nation is there that has gods near to it the way Jehovah our God is in all our calling upon him?

5012.label: Deuteronomy 4:8
5012.text: And what great nation is there that has righteous regulations and judicial decisions like all this law that I am putting before YOU today?

5013.label: Deuteronomy 4:9
5013.text: “Only watch out for yourself and take good care of your soul, that you may not forget the things that your eyes have seen and that they may not depart from your heart all the days of your life; and you must make them known to your sons and to your grandsons,

5014.label: Deuteronomy 4:10
5014.text: the day that you stood before Jehovah your God in Hoʹreb, when Jehovah said to me, ‘Congregate the people together to me that I may let them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they are alive on the soil and that they may teach their sons.’

5015.label: Deuteronomy 4:11
5015.text: “So YOU people came near and stood at the base of the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire up to midheaven; there was darkness, cloud and thick gloom.

5016.label: Deuteronomy 4:12
5016.text: And Jehovah began to speak to YOU out of the middle of the fire. The sound of words was what YOU were hearing, but no form were YOU seeing—nothing but a voice.

5017.label: Deuteronomy 4:13
5017.text: And he proceeded to state to YOU his covenant, which he commanded YOU to perform—the Ten Words, after which he wrote them upon two tablets of stone.

5018.label: Deuteronomy 4:14
5018.text: And it was I whom Jehovah commanded at that particular time to teach YOU regulations and judicial decisions, for YOU to do them in the land to which YOU are passing over to take possession of it.

5019.label: Deuteronomy 4:15
5019.text: “And YOU must take good care of YOUR souls, because YOU did not see any form on the day of Jehovah’s speaking to YOU in Hoʹreb out of the middle of the fire,

5020.label: Deuteronomy 4:16
5020.text: that YOU may not act ruinously and may not really make for yourselves a carved image, the form of any symbol, the representation of male or female,

5021.label: Deuteronomy 4:17
5021.text: the representation of any beast that is in the earth, the representation of any winged bird that flies in the heavens,

5022.label: Deuteronomy 4:18
5022.text: the representation of anything moving on the ground, the representation of any fish that is in the waters under the earth;

5023.label: Deuteronomy 4:19
5023.text: and that you may not raise your eyes to the heavens and indeed see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the army of the heavens, and actually get seduced and bow down to them and serve them, which Jehovah your God has apportioned to all the peoples under the whole heavens.

5024.label: Deuteronomy 4:20
5024.text: But YOU are the ones Jehovah took that he might bring YOU out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to become a people of private ownership to him as at this day.

5025.label: Deuteronomy 4:21
5025.text: “And Jehovah got incensed at me on YOUR account, so that he swore that I should not cross the Jordan or go into the good land that Jehovah your God is giving you as an inheritance.

5026.label: Deuteronomy 4:22
5026.text: For I am dying in this land. I am not crossing the Jordan, but YOU are crossing, and YOU must take possession of this good land.

5027.label: Deuteronomy 4:23
5027.text: Watch out for yourselves that YOU may not forget the covenant of Jehovah YOUR God that he concluded with YOU and that YOU do not make for yourselves a carved image, the form of anything about which Jehovah your God has commanded you.

5028.label: Deuteronomy 4:24
5028.text: For Jehovah your God is a consuming fire, a God exacting exclusive devotion.

5029.label: Deuteronomy 4:25
5029.text: “In case you become father to sons and grandsons and YOU have resided a long time in the land and do act ruinously and do make a carved image, a form of anything, and do commit evil in the eyes of Jehovah your God so as to offend him,

5030.label: Deuteronomy 4:26
5030.text: I do take as witnesses against YOU today the heavens and the earth, that YOU will positively perish in a hurry from off the land to which YOU are crossing the Jordan to take possession of it. YOU will not lengthen YOUR days on it, because YOU will positively be annihilated.

5031.label: Deuteronomy 4:27
5031.text: And Jehovah will certainly scatter YOU among the peoples, and YOU will indeed be let remain few in number among the nations to which Jehovah will drive YOU away.

5032.label: Deuteronomy 4:28
5032.text: And there YOU will have to serve gods, the product of the hands of man, wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.

5033.label: Deuteronomy 4:29
5033.text: “If YOU do look for Jehovah your God from there, you will also certainly find him, because you will inquire for him with all your heart and with all your soul.

5034.label: Deuteronomy 4:30
5034.text: When you are in sore straits and all these words have found you out at the close of the days, then you will have to return to Jehovah your God and to listen to his voice.

5035.label: Deuteronomy 4:31
5035.text: For Jehovah your God is a merciful God. He will not desert you or bring you to ruin or forget the covenant of your forefathers that he swore to them.

5036.label: Deuteronomy 4:32
5036.text: “Now ask, please, concerning the former days that occurred before you, from the day that God created man on the earth and from one end of the heavens clear to the other end of the heavens, Was any great thing brought about like this or was anything heard like it?

5037.label: Deuteronomy 4:33
5037.text: Has any other people heard the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire the way you yourself have heard it, and kept on living?

5038.label: Deuteronomy 4:34
5038.text: Or did God attempt to come to take a nation to himself out of the midst of another nation with provings, with signs and with miracles and with war and with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with great fearsomeness like all that Jehovah YOUR God has done for YOU in Egypt before your eyes?

5039.label: Deuteronomy 4:35
5039.text: You—you have been shown, so as to know that Jehovah is the [true] God; there is no other besides him.

5040.label: Deuteronomy 4:36
5040.text: Out of the heavens he made you hear his voice so as to correct you; and upon the earth he made you see his great fire, and his words you heard from the middle of the fire.

5041.label: Deuteronomy 4:37
5041.text: “And [yet you continue to live], because he loved your forefathers so that he chose their seed after them and brought you out of Egypt in his sight with his great power,

5042.label: Deuteronomy 4:38
5042.text: to drive away nations greater and mightier than you from before you, so as to bring you in, to give you their land as an inheritance as at this day.

5043.label: Deuteronomy 4:39
5043.text: And you well know today, and you must call back to your heart that Jehovah is the [true] God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath. There is no other.

5044.label: Deuteronomy 4:40
5044.text: And you must keep his regulations and his commandments that I am commanding you today, that it may go well with you and your sons after you, and in order that you may lengthen your days on the soil that Jehovah your God is giving you, always.”

5045.label: Deuteronomy 4:41
5045.text: At that time Moses proceeded to set apart three cities on the side of the Jordan toward the rising of the sun,

5046.label: Deuteronomy 4:42
5046.text: for the manslayer to flee there who slays his fellow without knowing it, while he was not hating him formerly; and he must flee to one of these cities and live,

5047.label: Deuteronomy 4:43
5047.text: namely, Beʹzer in the wilderness on the tableland for the Reuʹben·ites, and Raʹmoth in Gilʹe·ad for the Gadʹites, and Goʹlan in Baʹshan for the Ma·nasʹsites.

5048.label: Deuteronomy 4:44
5048.text: Now this is the law that Moses set before the sons of Israel.

5049.label: Deuteronomy 4:45
5049.text: These are the testimonies and the regulations and the judicial decisions that Moses spoke to the sons of Israel on their coming out of Egypt,

5050.label: Deuteronomy 4:46
5050.text: in the region of the Jordan in the valley in front of Beth-peʹor, in the land of Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites, who was dwelling in Heshʹbon, whom Moses and the sons of Israel defeated on their coming out of Egypt.

5051.label: Deuteronomy 4:47
5051.text: And they went taking possession of his land and of the land of Og the king of Baʹshan, the two kings of the Amʹor·ites who were in the region of the Jordan toward the rising of the sun,

5052.label: Deuteronomy 4:48
5052.text: from A·roʹer, which is on the bank of the torrent valley of Arʹnon, up to Mount Siʹon, that is to say, Herʹmon,

5053.label: Deuteronomy 4:49
5053.text: and all the Arʹa·bah in the region of the Jordan toward the east, and as far as the sea of the Arʹa·bah at the base of the slopes of Pisʹgah.

5054.label: Deuteronomy 5:1
5054.text: And Moses proceeded to call all Israel and to say to them: “Hear, O Israel, the regulations and the judicial decisions that I am speaking in YOUR ears today, and YOU must learn them and be careful to do them.

5055.label: Deuteronomy 5:2
5055.text: Jehovah our God concluded a covenant with us in Hoʹreb.

5056.label: Deuteronomy 5:3
5056.text: It was not with our forefathers that Jehovah concluded this covenant, but with us, all those of us alive here today.

5057.label: Deuteronomy 5:4
5057.text: Face to face Jehovah spoke with YOU in the mountain out of the middle of the fire.

5058.label: Deuteronomy 5:5
5058.text: I was standing between Jehovah and YOU at that particular time to tell YOU the word of Jehovah, (for YOU were afraid because of the fire and did not go up into the mountain,) saying,

5059.label: Deuteronomy 5:6
5059.text: “‘I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slaves.

5060.label: Deuteronomy 5:7
5060.text: You must never have any other gods against my face.

5061.label: Deuteronomy 5:8
5061.text: “‘You must not make for yourself a carved image, any form like anything that is in the heavens above or that is on the earth underneath or that is in the waters under the earth.

5062.label: Deuteronomy 5:9
5062.text: You must not bow down to them or be led to serve them, because I Jehovah your God am a God exacting exclusive devotion, bringing punishment for the error of fathers upon sons and upon the third generation and upon the fourth generation, in the case of those who hate me;

5063.label: Deuteronomy 5:10
5063.text: but exercising loving-kindness toward the thousandth generation in the case of those who love me and keep my commandments.

5064.label: Deuteronomy 5:11
5064.text: “‘You must not take up the name of Jehovah your God in a worthless way, for Jehovah will not leave anyone unpunished who takes up his name in a worthless way.

5065.label: Deuteronomy 5:12
5065.text: “‘Keeping the sabbath day to hold it sacred, just as Jehovah your God commanded you,

5066.label: Deuteronomy 5:13
5066.text: you are to render service and you must do all your work six days.

5067.label: Deuteronomy 5:14
5067.text: But the seventh day is a sabbath to Jehovah your God. You must not do any work, you nor your son nor your daughter nor your slave man nor your slave girl nor your bull nor your ass nor any domestic animal of yours nor your alien resident who is inside your gates, in order that your slave man and your slave girl may rest the same as you.

5068.label: Deuteronomy 5:15
5068.text: And you must remember that you became a slave in the land of Egypt and Jehovah your God proceeded to bring you out from there with a strong hand and an outstretched arm. That is why Jehovah your God commanded you to carry on the sabbath day.

5069.label: Deuteronomy 5:16
5069.text: “‘Honor your father and your mother, just as Jehovah your God has commanded you; in order that your days may prove long and it may go well with you on the ground that Jehovah your God is giving you.

5073.label: Deuteronomy 5:20
5073.text: “‘Neither must you testify to a falsehood against your fellowman.

5074.label: Deuteronomy 5:21
5074.text: “‘Neither must you desire your fellowman’s wife. Neither must you selfishly crave your fellowman’s house, his field or his slave man or his slave girl, his bull or his ass or anything that belongs to your fellowman.’

5075.label: Deuteronomy 5:22
5075.text: “These Words Jehovah spoke to all YOUR congregation in the mountain out of the middle of the fire, the cloud and the thick gloom, with a loud voice, and he added nothing; after which he wrote them upon two tablets of stone and gave me them.

5076.label: Deuteronomy 5:23
5076.text: “And it came about that as soon as YOU had heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, YOU proceeded to come near to me, all the heads of YOUR tribes and YOUR older men.

5077.label: Deuteronomy 5:24
5077.text: Then YOU said, ‘Here Jehovah our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. This day we have seen that God may speak with man and he may actually keep living.

5078.label: Deuteronomy 5:25
5078.text: And now why should we die, for this great fire may consume us? If we are again hearing the voice of Jehovah our God any further, we are also certain to die.

5079.label: Deuteronomy 5:26
5079.text: For who is there of all flesh that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire as we did and yet goes on living?

5080.label: Deuteronomy 5:27
5080.text: You yourself go near and hear all that Jehovah our God will say; and you will be the one to speak to us all that Jehovah our God will speak to you, and we shall certainly listen and do.’

5081.label: Deuteronomy 5:28
5081.text: “So Jehovah heard the voice of YOUR words when YOU spoke to me, and Jehovah went on to say to me, ‘I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken to you. They have done well in all they have spoken.

5082.label: Deuteronomy 5:29
5082.text: If only they would develop this heart of theirs to fear me and to keep all my commandments always, in order that it might go well with them and their sons to time indefinite!

5083.label: Deuteronomy 5:30
5083.text: Go say to them: “Return home to YOUR tents.”

5084.label: Deuteronomy 5:31
5084.text: And you stand here with me, and let me speak to you all the commandment and the regulations and the judicial decisions that you should teach to them and that they must do in the land that I am giving them to take possession of it.’

5085.label: Deuteronomy 5:32
5085.text: And YOU people must take care to do just as Jehovah YOUR God has commanded YOU. YOU must not turn to the right or to the left.

5086.label: Deuteronomy 5:33
5086.text: In all the way that Jehovah YOUR God has commanded YOU, YOU should walk, in order that YOU may live and it may be well with YOU and YOU may indeed lengthen YOUR days in the land of which YOU will take possession.

5087.label: Deuteronomy 6:1
5087.text: “Now these are the commandment, the regulations and the judicial decisions that Jehovah YOUR God has commanded to teach YOU, so as to do them in the land to which YOU are passing over there to take possession of it;

5088.label: Deuteronomy 6:2
5088.text: in order that you may fear Jehovah your God so as to keep all his statutes and his commandments that I am commanding you, you and your son and your grandson, all the days of your life, and in order that your days may prove long.

5089.label: Deuteronomy 6:3
5089.text: And you must listen, O Israel, and take care to do [them], that it may go well with you and that YOU may become very many, just as Jehovah the God of your forefathers has promised you, as respects the land flowing with milk and honey.

5090.label: Deuteronomy 6:4
5090.text: “Listen, O Israel: Jehovah our God is one Jehovah.

5091.label: Deuteronomy 6:5
5091.text: And you must love Jehovah your God with all your heart and all your soul and all your vital force.

5092.label: Deuteronomy 6:6
5092.text: And these words that I am commanding you today must prove to be on your heart;

5093.label: Deuteronomy 6:7
5093.text: and you must inculcate them in your son and speak of them when you sit in your house and when you walk on the road and when you lie down and when you get up.

5094.label: Deuteronomy 6:8
5094.text: And you must tie them as a sign upon your hand, and they must serve as a frontlet band between your eyes;

5095.label: Deuteronomy 6:9
5095.text: and you must write them upon the doorposts of your house and on your gates.

5096.label: Deuteronomy 6:10
5096.text: “And it must occur that when Jehovah your God will bring you into the land that he swore to your forefathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob to give you, great and good-looking cities that you did not build,

5097.label: Deuteronomy 6:11
5097.text: and houses full of all good things and that you did not fill, and cisterns hewn out that you did not hew out, vineyards and olive trees that you did not plant, and you shall have eaten and become satisfied,

5098.label: Deuteronomy 6:12
5098.text: watch out for yourself that you may not forget Jehovah, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slaves.

5099.label: Deuteronomy 6:13
5099.text: Jehovah your God you should fear, and him you should serve, and by his name you should swear.

5100.label: Deuteronomy 6:14
5100.text: YOU must not walk after other gods, any gods of the peoples who are all around YOU,

5101.label: Deuteronomy 6:15
5101.text: (for Jehovah your God in your midst is a God exacting exclusive devotion,) for fear the anger of Jehovah your God may blaze against you and he must annihilate you from off the surface of the ground.

5102.label: Deuteronomy 6:16
5102.text: “YOU must not put Jehovah YOUR God to the test, the way YOU put him to the test at Masʹsah.

5103.label: Deuteronomy 6:17
5103.text: YOU should by all means keep the commandments of Jehovah YOUR God and his testimonies and his regulations that he has commanded you.

5104.label: Deuteronomy 6:18
5104.text: And you must do what is right and good in Jehovah’s eyes, in order that it may go well with you and you may indeed enter and take possession of the good land about which Jehovah has sworn to your forefathers,

5105.label: Deuteronomy 6:19
5105.text: by pushing away all your enemies from before you, just as Jehovah has promised.

5106.label: Deuteronomy 6:20
5106.text: “In case your son should ask you in a future day, saying, ‘What do the testimonies and the regulations and the judicial decisions mean that Jehovah our God has commanded YOU?’

5107.label: Deuteronomy 6:21
5107.text: then you must say to your son, ‘We became slaves to Pharʹaoh in Egypt, but Jehovah proceeded to bring us out of Egypt with a strong hand.

5108.label: Deuteronomy 6:22
5108.text: So Jehovah kept putting signs and miracles, great and calamitous, upon Egypt, upon Pharʹaoh and upon all his household before our eyes.

5109.label: Deuteronomy 6:23
5109.text: And he brought us out from there in order that he might bring us here to give us the land about which he had sworn to our forefathers.

5110.label: Deuteronomy 6:24
5110.text: Hence Jehovah commanded us to carry out all these regulations, to fear Jehovah our God for our good always, that we might keep alive as at this day.

5111.label: Deuteronomy 6:25
5111.text: And it will mean righteousness for us, that we take care to do all this commandment before Jehovah our God, just as he has commanded us.’

5112.label: Deuteronomy 7:1
5112.text: “When Jehovah your God at last brings you into the land to which you are going so as to take possession of it, he must also clear away populous nations from before you, the Hitʹtites and the Girʹga·shites and the Amʹor·ites and the Caʹnaan·ites and the Perʹiz·zites and the Hiʹvites and the Jebʹu·sites, seven nations more populous and mighty than you are.

5113.label: Deuteronomy 7:2
5113.text: And Jehovah your God will certainly abandon them to you, and you must defeat them. You should without fail devote them to destruction. You must conclude no covenant with them nor show them any favor.

5114.label: Deuteronomy 7:3
5114.text: And you must form no marriage alliance with them. Your daughter you must not give to his son, and his daughter you must not take for your son.

5115.label: Deuteronomy 7:4
5115.text: For he will turn your son from following me, and they will certainly serve other gods; and Jehovah’s anger will indeed blaze against YOU, and he will certainly annihilate you in a hurry.

5116.label: Deuteronomy 7:5
5116.text: “On the other hand, this is what YOU should do to them: Their altars YOU should pull down, and their sacred pillars YOU should break down, and their sacred poles YOU should cut down, and their graven images YOU should burn with fire.

5117.label: Deuteronomy 7:6
5117.text: For you are a holy people to Jehovah your God. It is you Jehovah your God has chosen to become his people, a special property, out of all the peoples that are on the surface of the ground.

5118.label: Deuteronomy 7:7
5118.text: “It was not because of YOUR being the most populous of all the peoples that Jehovah showed affection for YOU so that he chose YOU, for YOU were the least of all the peoples.

5119.label: Deuteronomy 7:8
5119.text: But it was because of Jehovah’s loving YOU, and because of his keeping the sworn statement that he had sworn to YOUR forefathers, that Jehovah brought YOU out with a strong hand, that he might redeem you from the house of slaves, from the hand of Pharʹaoh the king of Egypt.

5120.label: Deuteronomy 7:9
5120.text: And you well know that Jehovah your God is the [true] God, the faithful God, keeping covenant and loving-kindness in the case of those who love him and those who keep his commandments to a thousand generations,

5121.label: Deuteronomy 7:10
5121.text: but repaying to his face the one who hates him by destroying him. He will not hesitate toward the one who hates him; he will repay him to his face.

5122.label: Deuteronomy 7:11
5122.text: And you must keep the commandment and the regulations and the judicial decisions that I am commanding you today by doing them.

5123.label: Deuteronomy 7:12
5123.text: “And it must occur that, because YOU continue listening to these judicial decisions and YOU do keep them and do carry them out, Jehovah your God must keep toward you the covenant and the loving-kindness about which he swore to your forefathers.

5124.label: Deuteronomy 7:13
5124.text: And he will certainly love you and bless you and multiply you and bless the fruit of your belly and the fruit of your soil, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the young of your cows and the progeny of your flock, on the soil that he swore to your forefathers to give to you.

5125.label: Deuteronomy 7:14
5125.text: The most blessed of all the peoples you will become. There will not prove to be in you a male or a female without offspring, nor among your domestic animals.

5126.label: Deuteronomy 7:15
5126.text: And Jehovah will certainly remove from you every sickness; and as for all the evil diseases of Egypt that you have known, he will not place them upon you, and he will indeed put them upon all those who hate you.

5127.label: Deuteronomy 7:16
5127.text: And you must consume all the peoples whom Jehovah your God is giving to you. Your eye must not feel sorry for them; and you must not serve their gods, because that will be a snare to you.

5128.label: Deuteronomy 7:17
5128.text: “In case you say in your heart, ‘These nations are too populous for me. How shall I be able to drive them away?’

5129.label: Deuteronomy 7:18
5129.text: you must not be afraid of them. You should by all means remember what Jehovah your God did to Pharʹaoh and all Egypt,

5130.label: Deuteronomy 7:19
5130.text: the great provings that your eyes saw, and the signs and the miracles and the strong hand and the outstretched arm with which Jehovah your God brought you out. That is the way Jehovah your God will do to all the peoples before whom you are afraid.

5131.label: Deuteronomy 7:20
5131.text: And Jehovah your God will also send the feeling of dejection upon them, until those perish who were let remain and who were concealing themselves from before you.

5132.label: Deuteronomy 7:21
5132.text: You must not suffer a shock because of them, for Jehovah your God is in your midst, a great and fear-inspiring God.

5133.label: Deuteronomy 7:22
5133.text: “And Jehovah your God will certainly push these nations away from before you little by little. You will not be allowed to finish them off quickly, for fear the wild beasts of the field may multiply against you.

5134.label: Deuteronomy 7:23
5134.text: And Jehovah your God will indeed abandon them to you and rout them with a great rout, until they are annihilated.

5135.label: Deuteronomy 7:24
5135.text: And he will certainly give their kings into your hand, and you must destroy their names from under the heavens. Nobody will take a firm stand against you, until you have exterminated them.

5136.label: Deuteronomy 7:25
5136.text: The graven images of their gods you should burn in the fire. You must not desire the silver and the gold upon them, nor indeed take it for yourself, for fear you may be ensnared by it; for it is a thing detestable to Jehovah your God.

5137.label: Deuteronomy 7:26
5137.text: And you must not bring a detestable thing into your house and actually become a thing devoted to destruction like it. You should thoroughly loathe it and absolutely detest it, because it is something devoted to destruction.

5138.label: Deuteronomy 8:1
5138.text: “Every commandment that I am commanding you today YOU should be careful to keep, in order that YOU may continue living and indeed multiply and go in and take possession of the land about which Jehovah swore to YOUR forefathers.

5139.label: Deuteronomy 8:2
5139.text: And you must remember all the way that Jehovah your God made you walk these forty years in the wilderness, in order to humble you, to put you to the test so as to know what was in your heart, as to whether you would keep his commandments or not.

5140.label: Deuteronomy 8:3
5140.text: So he humbled you and let you go hungry and fed you with the manna, which neither you had known nor your fathers had known; in order to make you know that not by bread alone does man live but by every expression of Jehovah’s mouth does man live.

5141.label: Deuteronomy 8:4
5141.text: Your mantle did not wear out upon you, nor did your foot become swollen these forty years.

5142.label: Deuteronomy 8:5
5142.text: And you well know with your own heart that just as a man corrects his son, Jehovah your God was correcting you.

5143.label: Deuteronomy 8:6
5143.text: “And you must keep the commandments of Jehovah your God by walking in his ways and by fearing him.

5144.label: Deuteronomy 8:7
5144.text: For Jehovah your God is bringing you into a good land, a land of torrent valleys of water, springs and watery deeps issuing forth in the valley plain and in the mountainous region,

5145.label: Deuteronomy 8:8
5145.text: a land of wheat and barley and vines and figs and pomegranates, a land of oil olives and honey,

5146.label: Deuteronomy 8:9
5146.text: a land in which you will not eat bread with scarcity, in which you will lack nothing, a land the stones of which are iron and out of the mountains of which you will mine copper.

5147.label: Deuteronomy 8:10
5147.text: “When you have eaten and satisfied yourself, you must also bless Jehovah your God for the good land that he has given you.

5148.label: Deuteronomy 8:11
5148.text: Watch out for yourself that you may not forget Jehovah your God so as not to keep his commandments and his judicial decisions and his statutes that I am commanding you today;

5149.label: Deuteronomy 8:12
5149.text: for fear that you may eat and indeed satisfy yourself, and you may build good houses and indeed dwell in them,

5150.label: Deuteronomy 8:13
5150.text: and your herd and your flock may increase, and silver and gold may increase for you, and all that is yours may increase;

5151.label: Deuteronomy 8:14
5151.text: and your heart may indeed be lifted up and you may indeed forget Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slaves;

5152.label: Deuteronomy 8:15
5152.text: who caused you to walk through the great and fear-inspiring wilderness, with poisonous serpents and scorpions and with thirsty ground that has no water; who brought forth water for you out of the flinty rock;

5153.label: Deuteronomy 8:16
5153.text: who fed you with manna in the wilderness, which your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and in order to put you to the test so as to do you good in your afterdays;

5154.label: Deuteronomy 8:17
5154.text: and you do say in your heart, ‘My own power and the full might of my own hand have made this wealth for me.’

5155.label: Deuteronomy 8:18
5155.text: And you must remember Jehovah your God, because he is the giver of power to you to make wealth; in order to carry out his covenant that he swore to your forefathers, as at this day.

5156.label: Deuteronomy 8:19
5156.text: “And it must occur that if you should at all forget Jehovah your God and you should actually walk after other gods and serve them and bow down to them, I do bear witness against YOU today that YOU people will absolutely perish.

5157.label: Deuteronomy 8:20
5157.text: Like the nations that Jehovah is destroying from before YOU, that is the way YOU will perish, because YOU will not listen to the voice of Jehovah YOUR God.

5158.label: Deuteronomy 9:1
5158.text: “Hear, O Israel, you are today crossing the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and mightier than you, cities great and fortified to the heavens,

5159.label: Deuteronomy 9:2
5159.text: a people great and tall, the sons of Anʹa·kim, about whom you yourself have known and you yourself have heard it said, ‘Who can make a firm stand before the sons of Aʹnak?’

5160.label: Deuteronomy 9:3
5160.text: And you well know today that Jehovah your God is crossing before you. A consuming fire he is. He will annihilate them, and he himself will subdue them before you; and you must dispossess them and destroy them speedily, just as Jehovah has spoken to you.

5161.label: Deuteronomy 9:4
5161.text: “Do not say in your heart when Jehovah your God pushes them away from before you this, ‘It was for my own righteousness that Jehovah has brought me in to take possession of this land,’ whereas it is for the wickedness of these nations that Jehovah is driving them away from before you.

5162.label: Deuteronomy 9:5
5162.text: It is not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart that you are going in to take possession of their land; in fact, it is for the wickedness of these nations that Jehovah your God is driving them away from before you, and in order to carry out the word that Jehovah swore to your forefathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

5163.label: Deuteronomy 9:6
5163.text: And you must know that it is not for your righteousness that Jehovah your God is giving you this good land to take possession of it; for you are a stiff-necked people.

5164.label: Deuteronomy 9:7
5164.text: “Remember: Do not forget how you have provoked Jehovah your God in the wilderness. From the day that you went out of the land of Egypt until YOUR coming to this place YOU people have proved rebellious in YOUR behavior with Jehovah.

5165.label: Deuteronomy 9:8
5165.text: Even in Hoʹreb YOU provoked Jehovah to anger so that Jehovah got incensed at YOU to the point of annihilating YOU.

5166.label: Deuteronomy 9:9
5166.text: When I went up the mountain to receive the stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant that Jehovah had concluded with YOU, and I kept dwelling in the mountain forty days and forty nights, (I neither ate bread nor drank water,)

5167.label: Deuteronomy 9:10
5167.text: then Jehovah gave me the two tablets of stone written upon with God’s finger; and upon them were all the words that Jehovah had spoken with YOU in the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the congregation.

5168.label: Deuteronomy 9:11
5168.text: And it came about that at the end of the forty days and forty nights Jehovah gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant;

5169.label: Deuteronomy 9:12
5169.text: and Jehovah proceeded to say to me, ‘Get up, go down quickly from here, because your people whom you brought out of Egypt have acted ruinously. They have turned aside quickly from the way about which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molten image.’

5170.label: Deuteronomy 9:13
5170.text: And Jehovah went on to say this to me, ‘I have seen this people, and, look! it is a stiff-necked people.

5171.label: Deuteronomy 9:14
5171.text: Let me alone that I may annihilate them and wipe out their name from under the heavens, and let me make you a nation mightier and more populous than they are.’

5172.label: Deuteronomy 9:15
5172.text: “After that I turned and went down from the mountain, while the mountain was burning with fire; and the two tablets of the covenant were in both my hands.

5173.label: Deuteronomy 9:16
5173.text: Then I looked, and there YOU had sinned against Jehovah YOUR God! YOU had made yourselves a molten calf. YOU had turned aside quickly from the way about which Jehovah had commanded YOU.

5174.label: Deuteronomy 9:17
5174.text: At that I took hold of the two tablets and flung them down from both my hands and shattered them before YOUR eyes.

5175.label: Deuteronomy 9:18
5175.text: And I proceeded to prostrate myself before Jehovah, as at first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all YOUR sin that YOU had committed in doing evil in the eyes of Jehovah so as to offend him.

5176.label: Deuteronomy 9:19
5176.text: For I was scared because of the hot anger with which Jehovah had got indignant at YOU to the point of annihilating YOU. However, Jehovah listened to me also that time.

5177.label: Deuteronomy 9:20
5177.text: “At Aaron, too, Jehovah got very incensed to the point of annihilating him; but I made supplication also in behalf of Aaron at that particular time.

5178.label: Deuteronomy 9:21
5178.text: And YOUR sin that YOU had made, the calf, I took, and I proceeded to burn it in the fire and to crush it, grinding it thoroughly until it had become fine like dust; after which I threw its dust into the torrent that was descending from the mountain.

5179.label: Deuteronomy 9:22
5179.text: “Further, at Tabʹe·rah and at Masʹsah and at Kibʹroth-hat·taʹa·vah YOU proved yourselves provokers of Jehovah to anger.

5180.label: Deuteronomy 9:23
5180.text: And when Jehovah sent YOU out of Kaʹdesh-barʹne·a, saying, ‘Go up and take possession of the land that I shall certainly give YOU!’ then YOU behaved rebelliously against the order of Jehovah YOUR God, and YOU did not exercise faith toward him and did not listen to his voice.

5181.label: Deuteronomy 9:24
5181.text: YOU have proved yourselves rebellious in behavior with Jehovah from the day of my knowing YOU.

5182.label: Deuteronomy 9:25
5182.text: “So I kept prostrating myself before Jehovah forty days and forty nights, for I prostrated myself thus because Jehovah talked of annihilating YOU.

5183.label: Deuteronomy 9:26
5183.text: And I began to make supplication to Jehovah and to say, ‘O Sovereign Lord Jehovah, do not bring to ruin your people, even your private property, whom you redeemed with your greatness, whom you brought out of Egypt with a strong hand.

5184.label: Deuteronomy 9:27
5184.text: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Do not turn your face to the hardness of this people and their wickedness and their sin,

5185.label: Deuteronomy 9:28
5185.text: for fear the land out of which you brought us may say: “Because Jehovah was unable to bring them into the land that he had promised them, and because he hated them he brought them out to put them to death in the wilderness.”

5186.label: Deuteronomy 9:29
5186.text: They are, too, your people and your private property whom you brought out with your great power and your outstretched arm.’

5187.label: Deuteronomy 10:1
5187.text: “At that particular time Jehovah said to me, ‘Carve for yourself two tablets of stone like the first ones, and come up to me into the mountain, and you must make an ark of wood for yourself.

5188.label: Deuteronomy 10:2
5188.text: And I shall write upon the tablets the words that appeared on the first tablets, which you shattered, and you must place them in the ark.’

5189.label: Deuteronomy 10:3
5189.text: So I made an ark of acacia wood and carved two tablets of stone like the first ones and went up into the mountain, and the two tablets were in my hand.

5190.label: Deuteronomy 10:4
5190.text: Then he wrote upon the tablets the same writing as the first, the Ten Words, which Jehovah had spoken to YOU in the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the congregation; after which Jehovah gave them to me.

5191.label: Deuteronomy 10:5
5191.text: Then I turned and went down from the mountain and placed the tablets in the ark that I had made, that they might continue there, just as Jehovah had commanded me.

5192.label: Deuteronomy 10:6
5192.text: “And the sons of Israel pulled away from Be·erʹoth Benʹe-jaʹa·kan for Mo·seʹrah. There Aaron died, and he got to be buried there; and El·e·aʹzar his son began to act as priest instead of him.

5193.label: Deuteronomy 10:7
5193.text: From there they pulled away for Gudʹgo·dah, and from Gudʹgo·dah for Jotʹba·thah, a land of torrent valleys running with water.

5194.label: Deuteronomy 10:8
5194.text: “At that particular time Jehovah separated the tribe of Leʹvi to carry the ark of Jehovah’s covenant, to stand before Jehovah for ministering to him and to bless in his name until this day.

5195.label: Deuteronomy 10:9
5195.text: That is why Leʹvi has come to have no share and inheritance with his brothers. Jehovah is his inheritance, just as Jehovah your God had said to him.

5196.label: Deuteronomy 10:10
5196.text: And I—I stayed in the mountain the same as the first days, forty days and forty nights, and Jehovah proceeded to listen to me also on that occasion. Jehovah did not want to bring you to ruin.

5197.label: Deuteronomy 10:11
5197.text: Then Jehovah said to me, ‘Get up, go before the people for a pulling away, that they may go in and take possession of the land that I have sworn to their forefathers to give to them.’

5198.label: Deuteronomy 10:12
5198.text: “And now, O Israel, what is Jehovah your God asking of you but to fear Jehovah your God, so as to walk in all his ways and to love him and to serve Jehovah your God with all your heart and all your soul;

5199.label: Deuteronomy 10:13
5199.text: to keep the commandments of Jehovah and his statutes that I am commanding you today, for your good?

5200.label: Deuteronomy 10:14
5200.text: Behold, to Jehovah your God belong the heavens, even the heavens of the heavens, the earth and all that is in it.

5201.label: Deuteronomy 10:15
5201.text: Only to your forefathers did Jehovah get attached so as to love them, so that he chose their offspring after them, even YOU, out of all the peoples, as at this day.

5202.label: Deuteronomy 10:16
5202.text: And YOU must circumcise the foreskin of YOUR hearts and not harden YOUR necks any longer.

5203.label: Deuteronomy 10:17
5203.text: For Jehovah YOUR God is the God of gods and the Lord of lords, the God great, mighty and fear-inspiring, who treats none with partiality nor accepts a bribe,

5204.label: Deuteronomy 10:18
5204.text: executing judgment for the fatherless boy and the widow and loving the alien resident so as to give him bread and a mantle.

5205.label: Deuteronomy 10:19
5205.text: YOU too must love the alien resident, for YOU became alien residents in the land of Egypt.

5206.label: Deuteronomy 10:20
5206.text: “Jehovah your God you should fear. Him you should serve, and to him you should cling, and by his name you should make sworn statements.

5207.label: Deuteronomy 10:21
5207.text: He is the One for you to praise, and he is your God, who has done with you these great and fear-inspiring things that your eyes have seen.

5208.label: Deuteronomy 10:22
5208.text: With seventy souls your forefathers went down into Egypt, and now Jehovah your God has constituted you like the stars of the heavens for multitude.

5209.label: Deuteronomy 11:1
5209.text: “And you must love Jehovah your God and keep your obligation to him and his statutes and his judicial decisions and his commandments always.

5210.label: Deuteronomy 11:2
5210.text: And YOU well know today (for [I do] not [address] YOUR sons who have not known and who have not seen the discipline of Jehovah YOUR God, his greatness, his strong hand and his outstretched arm,

5211.label: Deuteronomy 11:3
5211.text: nor his signs and his deeds that he did in the midst of Egypt to Pharʹaoh the king of Egypt and to all his land;

5212.label: Deuteronomy 11:4
5212.text: nor what he did to the military forces of Egypt, to his horses and his war chariots against the faces of which he made the waters of the Red Sea overflow when they were chasing after them, and Jehovah proceeded to destroy them till this day;

5213.label: Deuteronomy 11:5
5213.text: nor what he has done to YOU in the wilderness until YOUR coming to this place;

5214.label: Deuteronomy 11:6
5214.text: nor what he did to Daʹthan and A·biʹram the sons of E·liʹab the son of Reuʹben, when the earth opened its mouth and proceeded to swallow them up and their households and their tents and every existing thing that stepped after them in the midst of all Israel);

5215.label: Deuteronomy 11:7
5215.text: for YOUR eyes were the ones seeing all the great deeds of Jehovah that he did.

5216.label: Deuteronomy 11:8
5216.text: “And YOU must keep the whole commandment that I am commanding you today, in order that YOU may grow strong and may indeed enter in and take possession of the land to which YOU are crossing to take possession of it,

5217.label: Deuteronomy 11:9
5217.text: and in order that YOU may lengthen YOUR days on the soil that Jehovah swore to YOUR forefathers to give to them and their seed, a land flowing with milk and honey.

5218.label: Deuteronomy 11:10
5218.text: “For the land to which you are going to take possession of it is not like the land of Egypt out of which YOU came, where you used to sow your seed and you had to do irrigating with your foot, like a garden of vegetables.

5219.label: Deuteronomy 11:11
5219.text: But the land to which YOU are crossing to take possession of it is a land of mountains and valley plains. Of the rain of the heavens it drinks water;

5220.label: Deuteronomy 11:12
5220.text: a land that Jehovah your God is caring for. The eyes of Jehovah your God are constantly upon it, from the beginning of the year to the close of the year.

5221.label: Deuteronomy 11:13
5221.text: “And it must occur that if YOU will without fail obey my commandments that I am commanding YOU today so as to love Jehovah YOUR God and to serve him with all YOUR heart and all YOUR soul,

5222.label: Deuteronomy 11:14
5222.text: I also shall certainly give rain for YOUR land at its appointed time, autumn rain and spring rain, and you will indeed gather your grain and your sweet wine and your oil.

5223.label: Deuteronomy 11:15
5223.text: And I shall certainly give vegetation in your field for your domestic animals, and you will indeed eat and be satisfied.

5224.label: Deuteronomy 11:16
5224.text: Watch out for yourselves for fear YOUR heart may be enticed, and YOU do turn aside and worship other gods and bow down to them,

5225.label: Deuteronomy 11:17
5225.text: and Jehovah’s anger does blaze against YOU, and he does shut up the heavens so that no rain will occur and the ground will not give its produce and YOU have to perish speedily from off the good land that Jehovah is giving YOU.

5226.label: Deuteronomy 11:18
5226.text: “And YOU must apply these words of mine to YOUR heart and YOUR soul and bind them as a sign upon YOUR hand, and they must serve as a frontlet band between YOUR eyes.

5227.label: Deuteronomy 11:19
5227.text: YOU must also teach them to YOUR sons, so as to speak of them when you sit in your house and when you walk on the road and when you lie down and when you get up.

5228.label: Deuteronomy 11:20
5228.text: And you must write them upon the doorposts of your house and on your gates,

5229.label: Deuteronomy 11:21
5229.text: in order that YOUR days and the days of YOUR sons may be many on the soil that Jehovah swore to YOUR forefathers to give to them, as the days of the heavens over the earth.

5230.label: Deuteronomy 11:22
5230.text: “For if YOU strictly keep all this commandment that I am commanding YOU so as to do it, to love Jehovah YOUR God, to walk in all his ways and to cling to him,

5231.label: Deuteronomy 11:23
5231.text: Jehovah also must drive away all these nations on account of YOU, and YOU will certainly dispossess nations greater and more numerous than YOU are.

5232.label: Deuteronomy 11:24
5232.text: Every place on which the sole of YOUR foot will tread will become YOURS. From the wilderness up to Lebʹa·non, from the River, the river Eu·phraʹtes, to the western sea YOUR boundary will become.

5233.label: Deuteronomy 11:25
5233.text: No man will make a firm stand against YOU. The dread of YOU and the fear of YOU Jehovah YOUR God will put before the face of all the land on which YOU will tread, just as he has promised YOU.

5234.label: Deuteronomy 11:26
5234.text: “See, I am putting before YOU today blessing and malediction:

5235.label: Deuteronomy 11:27
5235.text: the blessing, provided YOU will obey the commandments of Jehovah YOUR God that I am commanding YOU today;

5236.label: Deuteronomy 11:28
5236.text: and the malediction, if YOU will not obey the commandments of Jehovah YOUR God and YOU do turn aside from the way about which I am commanding YOU today, so as to walk after other gods whom YOU have not known.

5237.label: Deuteronomy 11:29
5237.text: “And it must occur that when Jehovah your God brings you into the land to which you are going to take possession of it, you must also give the blessing upon Mount Gerʹi·zim and the malediction upon Mount Eʹbal.

5238.label: Deuteronomy 11:30
5238.text: Are they not on the side of the Jordan toward the direction of the sunset, in the land of the Caʹnaan·ites dwelling in the Arʹa·bah, in front of Gilʹgal, beside the big trees of Moʹreh?

5239.label: Deuteronomy 11:31
5239.text: For YOU are crossing the Jordan to go in and take possession of the land that Jehovah YOUR God is giving YOU, and YOU must take possession of it and dwell in it.

5240.label: Deuteronomy 11:32
5240.text: And YOU must be careful to carry out all the regulations and the judicial decisions that I am putting before YOU today.

5241.label: Deuteronomy 12:1
5241.text: “These are the regulations and the judicial decisions that YOU should be careful to carry out in the land that Jehovah the God of your forefathers will certainly allow you to take possession of, all the days that YOU are alive on the soil.

5242.label: Deuteronomy 12:2
5242.text: YOU should absolutely destroy all the places where the nations whom YOU are dispossessing have served their gods, on the tall mountains and the hills and under every luxuriant tree.

5243.label: Deuteronomy 12:3
5243.text: And YOU must pull down their altars and shatter their sacred pillars, and YOU should burn their sacred poles in the fire and cut down the graven images of their gods, and YOU must destroy their names from that place.

5244.label: Deuteronomy 12:4
5244.text: “YOU must not do that way to Jehovah YOUR God,

5245.label: Deuteronomy 12:5
5245.text: but to the place that Jehovah YOUR God will choose out of all YOUR tribes to place his name there, to have it reside, YOU will seek, and there you must come.

5246.label: Deuteronomy 12:6
5246.text: And there YOU must bring YOUR burnt offerings and YOUR sacrifices and YOUR tenth parts and the contribution of YOUR hand and YOUR vow offerings and YOUR voluntary offerings and the firstborn ones of YOUR herd and of YOUR flock.

5247.label: Deuteronomy 12:7
5247.text: And there YOU must eat before Jehovah YOUR God and rejoice in every undertaking of YOURS, YOU and YOUR households, because Jehovah your God has blessed you.

5248.label: Deuteronomy 12:8
5248.text: “YOU must not do according to all that we are doing here today, each one whatever is right in his own eyes,

5249.label: Deuteronomy 12:9
5249.text: because YOU have not yet come into the resting-place and the inheritance that Jehovah your God is giving you.

5250.label: Deuteronomy 12:10
5250.text: And YOU must cross the Jordan and dwell in the land that Jehovah YOUR God is giving YOU as a possession, and he will certainly give YOU rest from all YOUR enemies round about, and YOU will indeed dwell in security.

5251.label: Deuteronomy 12:11
5251.text: And it must occur that the place that Jehovah YOUR God will choose to have his name reside there is where YOU will bring all about which I am commanding YOU, YOUR burnt offerings and YOUR sacrifices, YOUR tenth parts and the contribution of YOUR hand and every choice of YOUR vow offerings that YOU will vow to Jehovah.

5252.label: Deuteronomy 12:12
5252.text: And YOU must rejoice before Jehovah YOUR God, YOU and YOUR sons and YOUR daughters and YOUR man slaves and YOUR slave girls and the Levite who is inside YOUR gates, because he has no share or inheritance with YOU.

5253.label: Deuteronomy 12:13
5253.text: Watch out for yourself for fear you may offer up your burnt offerings in any other place you may see.

5254.label: Deuteronomy 12:14
5254.text: But in the place that Jehovah will choose in one of your tribes is where you should offer up your burnt offerings, and there you should do all that I am commanding you.

5255.label: Deuteronomy 12:15
5255.text: “Only whenever your soul craves it you may slaughter, and you must eat meat according to the blessing of Jehovah your God that he has given you, inside all your gates. The unclean one and the clean one may eat it, like the gazelle and like the stag.

5256.label: Deuteronomy 12:16
5256.text: Only the blood YOU must not eat. On the earth you should pour it out as water.

5257.label: Deuteronomy 12:17
5257.text: You will not be allowed to eat inside your gates the tenth part of your grain or of your new wine or of your oil or the firstborn ones of your herd and of your flock or any of your vow offerings that you will vow or your voluntary offerings or the contribution of your hand.

5258.label: Deuteronomy 12:18
5258.text: But before Jehovah your God you will eat it, in the place that Jehovah your God will choose, you and your son and your daughter and your man slave and your slave girl and the Levite who is inside your gates; and you must rejoice before Jehovah your God in every undertaking of yours.

5259.label: Deuteronomy 12:19
5259.text: Watch out for yourself that you may not abandon the Levite all your days on your soil.

5260.label: Deuteronomy 12:20
5260.text: “When Jehovah your God will widen out your territory, just as he has promised you, and you will be certain to say, ‘Let me eat meat,’ because your soul craves to eat meat, whenever your soul craves it you may eat meat.

5261.label: Deuteronomy 12:21
5261.text: In case the place that Jehovah your God will choose to put his name there should be far away from you, you must then slaughter some of your herd or some of your flock that Jehovah has given you, just as I have commanded you, and you must eat inside your gates whenever your soul craves it.

5262.label: Deuteronomy 12:22
5262.text: Only in the way that the gazelle and the stag may be eaten, so you may eat it: the unclean one and the clean one together may eat it.

5263.label: Deuteronomy 12:23
5263.text: Simply be firmly resolved not to eat the blood, because the blood is the soul and you must not eat the soul with the flesh.

5264.label: Deuteronomy 12:24
5264.text: You must not eat it. You should pour it out upon the ground as water.

5265.label: Deuteronomy 12:25
5265.text: You must not eat it, in order that it may go well with you and your sons after you, because you will do what is right in Jehovah’s eyes.

5266.label: Deuteronomy 12:26
5266.text: Merely your holy things that will become yours, and your vow offerings you should carry, and you must come to the place that Jehovah will choose.

5267.label: Deuteronomy 12:27
5267.text: And you must render up your burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of Jehovah your God; and the blood of your sacrifices should be poured out against the altar of Jehovah your God, but the flesh you may eat.

5268.label: Deuteronomy 12:28
5268.text: “Watch, and you must obey all these words that I am commanding you, in order that it may go well with you and your sons after you to time indefinite, because you will do what is good and right in the eyes of Jehovah your God.

5269.label: Deuteronomy 12:29
5269.text: “When Jehovah your God will cut off from before you the nations to whom you are going to dispossess them, you must also dispossess them and dwell in their land.

5270.label: Deuteronomy 12:30
5270.text: Watch out for yourself for fear you may be entrapped after them, after they have been annihilated from before you, and for fear you may inquire respecting their gods, saying, ‘How was it these nations used to serve their gods? And I, yes, I, will do the same way.’

5271.label: Deuteronomy 12:31
5271.text: You must not do that way to Jehovah your God, for everything detestable to Jehovah that he does hate they have done to their gods, for even their sons and their daughters they regularly burn in the fire to their gods.

5272.label: Deuteronomy 12:32
5272.text: Every word that I am commanding YOU is what YOU should be careful to do. YOU must not add to it nor take away from it.

5273.label: Deuteronomy 13:1
5273.text: “In case a prophet or a dreamer of a dream arises in your midst and does give you a sign or a portent,

5274.label: Deuteronomy 13:2
5274.text: and the sign or the portent does come true of which he spoke to you, saying, ‘Let us walk after other gods, whom you have not known, and let us serve them,’

5275.label: Deuteronomy 13:3
5275.text: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or to the dreamer of that dream, because Jehovah YOUR God is testing YOU to know whether YOU are loving Jehovah YOUR God with all YOUR heart and all YOUR soul.

5276.label: Deuteronomy 13:4
5276.text: After Jehovah YOUR God YOU should walk, and him YOU should fear, and his commandments YOU should keep, and to his voice YOU should listen, and him YOU should serve, and to him YOU should cling.

5277.label: Deuteronomy 13:5
5277.text: And that prophet or that dreamer of the dream should be put to death, because he has spoken of revolt against Jehovah YOUR God, who has brought YOU out of the land of Egypt and has redeemed you from the house of slaves, to turn you from the way in which Jehovah your God has commanded you to walk; and you must clear out what is evil from your midst.

5278.label: Deuteronomy 13:6
5278.text: “In case your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter or your cherished wife or your companion who is like your own soul, should try to allure you in secrecy, saying, ‘Let us go and serve other gods,’ whom you have not known, neither you nor your forefathers,

5279.label: Deuteronomy 13:7
5279.text: some of the gods of the peoples who are all around YOU, the ones near you or those far away from you, from one end of the land to the other end of the land,

5280.label: Deuteronomy 13:8
5280.text: you must not accede to his wish or listen to him, nor should your eye feel sorry for him, nor must you feel compassion, nor cover him [protectively];

5281.label: Deuteronomy 13:9
