5281.text: but you should kill him without fail. Your hand first of all should come upon him to put him to death, and the hand of all the people afterward.

5282.label: Deuteronomy 13:10
5282.text: And you must stone him with stones, and he must die, because he has sought to turn you away from Jehovah your God, who has brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slaves.

5283.label: Deuteronomy 13:11
5283.text: Then all Israel will hear and become afraid, and they will not do anything like this bad thing again in your midst.

5284.label: Deuteronomy 13:12
5284.text: “In case you hear it said in one of your cities, which Jehovah your God is giving you to dwell there,

5285.label: Deuteronomy 13:13
5285.text: ‘Good-for-nothing men have gone out from your midst that they may try to turn away the inhabitants of their city, saying: “Let us go and serve other gods,” whom you have not known,’

5286.label: Deuteronomy 13:14
5286.text: you must also search and investigate and inquire thoroughly; and if the thing is established as the truth, this detestable thing has been done in your midst,

5287.label: Deuteronomy 13:15
5287.text: you should without fail strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword. Devote it and everything that is in it, and its domestic animals, to destruction at the edge of the sword.

5288.label: Deuteronomy 13:16
5288.text: And all its spoil you should collect into the middle of its public square, and you must burn in the fire the city and all its spoil as a whole offering to Jehovah your God, and it must become a heap of ruins to time indefinite. It should never be rebuilt.

5289.label: Deuteronomy 13:17
5289.text: And nothing at all should stick to your hand of the thing made sacred by ban, in order that Jehovah may turn from his burning anger and may indeed give you mercy and he may certainly show you mercy and multiply you, just as he has sworn to your forefathers.

5290.label: Deuteronomy 13:18
5290.text: For you should listen to the voice of Jehovah your God by keeping all his commandments that I am commanding you today, so as to do what is right in the eyes of Jehovah your God.

5291.label: Deuteronomy 14:1
5291.text: “Sons YOU are of Jehovah YOUR God. YOU must not make cuttings upon yourselves or impose baldness on YOUR foreheads for a dead person.

5292.label: Deuteronomy 14:2
5292.text: For you are a holy people to Jehovah your God, and Jehovah has chosen you to become his people, a special property, out of all the peoples who are on the surface of the ground.

5293.label: Deuteronomy 14:3
5293.text: “You must eat no detestable thing of any sort.

5294.label: Deuteronomy 14:4
5294.text: This is the sort of beast that YOU may eat: the bull, the sheep and the goat,

5295.label: Deuteronomy 14:5
5295.text: the stag and gazelle and roebuck and wild goat and antelope and wild sheep and chamois;

5296.label: Deuteronomy 14:6
5296.text: and every beast that splits the hoof and that forms a cleft into two hoofs, chewing the cud among the beasts. It YOU may eat.

5297.label: Deuteronomy 14:7
5297.text: Only this sort YOU must not eat out of those that chew the cud or that split the hoof, cloven: the camel and the hare and the rock badger, because they are chewers of the cud but do not split the hoof. They are unclean for YOU.

5298.label: Deuteronomy 14:8
5298.text: The pig also, because it is a splitter of the hoof but there is no cud. It is unclean for YOU. None of their flesh must YOU eat, and their carcasses YOU must not touch.

5299.label: Deuteronomy 14:9
5299.text: “This sort out of everything that is in the waters YOU may eat: Everything that has fins and scales YOU may eat.

5300.label: Deuteronomy 14:10
5300.text: And everything that has no fins and scales YOU must not eat. It is unclean for YOU.

5302.label: Deuteronomy 14:12
5302.text: But these are the ones of which YOU must not eat: the eagle and the osprey and the black vulture,

5303.label: Deuteronomy 14:13
5303.text: and the red kite and the black kite and the glede according to its kind;

5304.label: Deuteronomy 14:14
5304.text: and every raven according to its kind;

5305.label: Deuteronomy 14:15
5305.text: and the ostrich and the owl and the gull and the falcon according to its kind;

5306.label: Deuteronomy 14:16
5306.text: the little owl and the long-eared owl and the swan,

5307.label: Deuteronomy 14:17
5307.text: and the pelican and the vulture and the cormorant,

5308.label: Deuteronomy 14:18
5308.text: and the stork and the heron according to its kind, and the hoopoe and the bat.

5309.label: Deuteronomy 14:19
5309.text: And every winged swarming creature is unclean for YOU. They should not be eaten.

5310.label: Deuteronomy 14:20
5310.text: Any clean flying creature YOU may eat.

5311.label: Deuteronomy 14:21
5311.text: “YOU must not eat any body [already] dead. To the alien resident who is inside your gates you may give it, and he must eat it; or there may be a selling of it to a foreigner, because you are a holy people to Jehovah your God. “You must not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.

5312.label: Deuteronomy 14:22
5312.text: “Without fail you should give a tenth of all the produce of your seed, that which comes forth of the field year by year.

5313.label: Deuteronomy 14:23
5313.text: And before Jehovah your God, in the place that he will choose to have his name reside there, you must eat the tenth part of your grain, your new wine and your oil and the firstborn ones of your herd and of your flock; in order that you may learn to fear Jehovah your God always.

5314.label: Deuteronomy 14:24
5314.text: “Now in case the journey should be too long for you, because you will not be able to carry it, since the place that Jehovah your God will choose to place his name there will be too far away for you, (because Jehovah your God will bless you,)

5315.label: Deuteronomy 14:25
5315.text: you must then turn it into money, and you must wrap the money up in your hand and travel to the place that Jehovah your God will choose.

5316.label: Deuteronomy 14:26
5316.text: You must also give the money for whatever your soul may crave in the way of cattle and sheep and goats and wine and intoxicating liquor and anything that your soul may ask of you; and you must eat there before Jehovah your God and rejoice, you and your household.

5317.label: Deuteronomy 14:27
5317.text: And the Levite who is inside your gates, you must not abandon him, for he has no share or inheritance with you.

5318.label: Deuteronomy 14:28
5318.text: “At the end of three years you will bring out the entire tenth part of your produce in that year, and you must deposit it inside your gates.

5319.label: Deuteronomy 14:29
5319.text: And the Levite, because he has no share or inheritance with you, and the alien resident and the fatherless boy and the widow, who are inside your gates, must come, and they must eat and satisfy themselves; in order that Jehovah your God may bless you in every deed of your hand that you will do.

5320.label: Deuteronomy 15:1
5320.text: “At the end of every seven years you should make a release.

5321.label: Deuteronomy 15:2
5321.text: And this is the manner of the release: there will be a releasing by every creditor of the debt that he may let his fellow incur. He should not press his fellow or his brother for payment, because a release to Jehovah must be called.

5322.label: Deuteronomy 15:3
5322.text: The foreigner you may press for payment; but whatever of yours may prove to be with your brother let your hand release.

5323.label: Deuteronomy 15:4
5323.text: However, no one should come to be poor among you, because Jehovah will without fail bless you in the land that Jehovah your God is giving you as an inheritance to take possession of it,

5324.label: Deuteronomy 15:5
5324.text: only if you will without fail listen to the voice of Jehovah your God so as to be careful to do all this commandment that I am commanding you today.

5325.label: Deuteronomy 15:6
5325.text: For Jehovah your God will indeed bless you just as he has promised you, and you will certainly lend on pledge to many nations, whereas you yourself will not borrow; and you must dominate over many nations, whereas over you they will not dominate.

5326.label: Deuteronomy 15:7
5326.text: “In case some one of your brothers becomes poor among you in one of your cities, in your land that Jehovah your God is giving you, you must not harden your heart or be closefisted toward your poor brother.

5327.label: Deuteronomy 15:8
5327.text: For you should generously open your hand to him and by all means lend him on pledge as much as he needs, which he is in want of.

5328.label: Deuteronomy 15:9
5328.text: Watch out for yourself for fear a base word should come to be in your heart, saying, ‘The seventh year, the year of the release, has come close,’ and your eye should indeed become ungenerous toward your poor brother, and you should give him nothing, and he has to call out to Jehovah against you, and it has become a sin on your part.

5329.label: Deuteronomy 15:10
5329.text: You should by all means give to him, and your heart should not be stingy in your giving to him, because on this account Jehovah your God will bless you in every deed of yours and in every undertaking of yours.

5330.label: Deuteronomy 15:11
5330.text: For someone poor will never cease to be in the midst of the land. That is why I am commanding you, saying, ‘You should generously open up your hand to your afflicted and poor brother in your land.’

5331.label: Deuteronomy 15:12
5331.text: “In case there should be sold to you your brother, a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, and he has served you six years, then in the seventh year you should send him out from you as one set free.

5332.label: Deuteronomy 15:13
5332.text: And in case you should send him out from you as one set free, you must not send him out empty-handed.

5333.label: Deuteronomy 15:14
5333.text: You should surely equip him with something from your flock and your threshing floor and your oil and winepress. Just as Jehovah your God has blessed you, you should give to him.

5334.label: Deuteronomy 15:15
5334.text: And you must remember that you became a slave in the land of Egypt and Jehovah your God proceeded to redeem you. That is why I am commanding you this thing today.

5335.label: Deuteronomy 15:16
5335.text: “And it must occur that in case he says to you, ‘I shall not go out from your company!’ because he does love you and your household, since it was well with him while with you,

5336.label: Deuteronomy 15:17
5336.text: you must also take an awl and put it through his ear and to the door, and he must become your slave to time indefinite. And to your slave girl you should also do this way.

5337.label: Deuteronomy 15:18
5337.text: It should not be something hard in your eyes when you send him out from your company as one set free; because for double the value of a hired laborer he served you six years, and Jehovah your God has blessed you in everything that you would do.

5338.label: Deuteronomy 15:19
5338.text: “Every male firstborn that will be born in your herd and in your flock you should sanctify to Jehovah your God. You must do no service with the firstborn of your bull, nor shear the firstborn of your flock.

5339.label: Deuteronomy 15:20
5339.text: Before Jehovah your God you should eat it year by year in the place that Jehovah will choose, you and your household.

5340.label: Deuteronomy 15:21
5340.text: And in case there should prove to be in it a defect, being lame or blind, any bad defect, you must not sacrifice it to Jehovah your God.

5341.label: Deuteronomy 15:22
5341.text: Inside your gates you should eat it, the unclean one and the clean one together, like the gazelle and like the stag.

5342.label: Deuteronomy 15:23
5342.text: Only its blood you must not eat. Upon the earth you should pour it out as water.

5343.label: Deuteronomy 16:1
5343.text: “Let there be an observing of the month of Aʹbib, and you must celebrate the passover to Jehovah your God, because in the month of Aʹbib Jehovah your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

5344.label: Deuteronomy 16:2
5344.text: And you must sacrifice the passover to Jehovah your God, of the flock and of the herd, in the place that Jehovah will choose to have his name reside there.

5345.label: Deuteronomy 16:3
5345.text: You must eat nothing leavened along with it for seven days. You should eat along with it unfermented cakes, the bread of affliction, because it was in haste that you came out of the land of Egypt, that you may remember the day of your coming out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.

5346.label: Deuteronomy 16:4
5346.text: And no sourdough should be seen with you in all your territory seven days, neither should any of the flesh, which you will sacrifice in the evening on the first day, stay all night until the morning.

5347.label: Deuteronomy 16:5
5347.text: You will not be allowed to sacrifice the passover in any one of your cities that Jehovah your God is giving you.

5348.label: Deuteronomy 16:6
5348.text: But at the place that Jehovah your God will choose to have his name reside there, you should sacrifice the passover in the evening as soon as the sun sets, at the appointed time of your coming out of Egypt.

5349.label: Deuteronomy 16:7
5349.text: And you must do the boiling and the eating in the place that Jehovah your God will choose, and in the morning you must turn around and go to your own tents.

5350.label: Deuteronomy 16:8
5350.text: Six days you should eat unfermented cakes; and on the seventh day there will be a solemn assembly to Jehovah your God. You must do no work.

5351.label: Deuteronomy 16:9
5351.text: “Seven weeks you should count for yourself. From when the sickle is first put to the standing grain you will start to count seven weeks.

5352.label: Deuteronomy 16:10
5352.text: Then you must celebrate the festival of weeks to Jehovah your God, according to the voluntary offering of your hand that you will give, just as Jehovah your God may bless you.

5353.label: Deuteronomy 16:11
5353.text: And you must rejoice before Jehovah your God, you and your son and your daughter and your man slave and your slave girl and the Levite who is inside your gates and the alien resident and the fatherless boy and the widow, who are in your midst, in the place that Jehovah your God will choose to have his name reside there.

5354.label: Deuteronomy 16:12
5354.text: And you must remember that you became a slave in Egypt, and you must observe and carry out these regulations.

5355.label: Deuteronomy 16:13
5355.text: “The festival of booths you should celebrate for yourself seven days when you make an ingathering from your threshing floor and your oil and winepress.

5356.label: Deuteronomy 16:14
5356.text: And you must rejoice during your festival, you and your son and your daughter and your man slave and your slave girl and the Levite and the alien resident and the fatherless boy and the widow, who are inside your gates.

5357.label: Deuteronomy 16:15
5357.text: Seven days you will celebrate the festival to Jehovah your God in the place that Jehovah will choose, because Jehovah your God will bless you in all your produce and in every deed of your hand, and you must become nothing but joyful.

5358.label: Deuteronomy 16:16
5358.text: “Three times in the year every male of yours should appear before Jehovah your God in the place that he will choose: in the festival of the unfermented cakes and in the festival of weeks and in the festival of booths, and none should appear before Jehovah empty-handed.

5359.label: Deuteronomy 16:17
5359.text: The gift of each one’s hand should be in proportion to the blessing of Jehovah your God that he has given you.

5360.label: Deuteronomy 16:18
5360.text: “You should set judges and officers for yourself inside all your gates that Jehovah your God is giving you by your tribes, and they must judge the people with righteous judgment.

5361.label: Deuteronomy 16:19
5361.text: You must not pervert judgment. You must not be partial or accept a bribe, for the bribe blinds the eyes of wise ones and distorts the words of righteous ones.

5362.label: Deuteronomy 16:20
5362.text: Justice—justice you should pursue, in order that you may keep alive and may indeed take possession of the land that Jehovah your God is giving you.

5363.label: Deuteronomy 16:21
5363.text: “You must not plant for yourself any sort of tree as a sacred pole near the altar of Jehovah your God that you will make for yourself.

5364.label: Deuteronomy 16:22
5364.text: “Neither should you set up for yourself a sacred pillar, a thing Jehovah your God hates indeed.

5365.label: Deuteronomy 17:1
5365.text: “You must not sacrifice to Jehovah your God a bull or a sheep in which there proves to be a defect, anything bad; because it is a thing detestable to Jehovah your God.

5366.label: Deuteronomy 17:2
5366.text: “In case there should be found in your midst in one of your cities that Jehovah your God is giving you a man or a woman who should practice what is bad in the eyes of Jehovah your God so as to overstep his covenant,

5367.label: Deuteronomy 17:3
5367.text: and he should go and worship other gods and bow down to them or to the sun or the moon or all the army of the heavens, a thing that I have not commanded,

5368.label: Deuteronomy 17:4
5368.text: and it has been told you and you have heard it and have searched thoroughly, and, look! the thing is established as the truth, this detestable thing has been done in Israel!

5369.label: Deuteronomy 17:5
5369.text: you must also bring that man or that woman who has done this bad thing out to your gates, yes, the man or the woman, and you must stone such one with stones, and such one must die.

5370.label: Deuteronomy 17:6
5370.text: At the mouth of two witnesses or of three witnesses the one dying should be put to death. He will not be put to death at the mouth of one witness.

5371.label: Deuteronomy 17:7
5371.text: The hand of the witnesses first of all should come upon him to put him to death, and the hand of all the people afterward; and you must clear out what is bad from your midst.

5372.label: Deuteronomy 17:8
5372.text: “In case a matter for judicial decision should be too extraordinary for you, one in which blood has been shed, in which a legal claim has been raised, or a violent deed has been committed, matters of dispute, inside your gates, you must also rise and go up to the place that Jehovah your God will choose,

5373.label: Deuteronomy 17:9
5373.text: and you must go to the priests, the Levites, and to the judge who will be acting in those days, and you must make inquiry, and they must hand down to you the word of the judicial decision.

5374.label: Deuteronomy 17:10
5374.text: Then you must do in accordance with the word that they will hand down to you from that place which Jehovah will choose; and you must be careful to do according to all that they instruct you.

5375.label: Deuteronomy 17:11
5375.text: In accordance with the law that they will point out to you, and according to the judicial decision that they will say to you, you should do. You must not turn aside from the word that they will hand down to you, to the right or to the left.

5376.label: Deuteronomy 17:12
5376.text: And the man who will behave with presumptuousness in not listening to the priest who is standing to minister there to Jehovah your God or to the judge, that man must die; and you must clear out what is bad from Israel.

5377.label: Deuteronomy 17:13
5377.text: And all the people will hear and become afraid, and they will not act presumptuously anymore.

5378.label: Deuteronomy 17:14
5378.text: “When you eventually come into the land that Jehovah your God is giving you, and you have taken possession of it and have dwelt in it, and you have said, ‘Let me set a king over myself like all the nations who are round about me’;

5379.label: Deuteronomy 17:15
5379.text: you should without fail set over yourself a king whom Jehovah your God will choose. From among your brothers you should set a king over yourself. You will not be allowed to put over yourself a foreigner who is not your brother.

5380.label: Deuteronomy 17:16
5380.text: Only he should not increase horses for himself, nor make the people go back to Egypt in order to increase horses; whereas Jehovah has said to YOU, ‘YOU must never go back again by this way.’

5381.label: Deuteronomy 17:17
5381.text: He should also not multiply wives for himself, that his heart may not turn aside; nor should he increase silver and gold for himself very much.

5382.label: Deuteronomy 17:18
5382.text: And it must occur that when he takes his seat on the throne of his kingdom, he must write in a book for himself a copy of this law from that which is in the charge of the priests, the Levites.

5383.label: Deuteronomy 17:19
5383.text: “And it must continue with him, and he must read in it all the days of his life, in order that he may learn to fear Jehovah his God so as to keep all the words of this law and these regulations by doing them;

5384.label: Deuteronomy 17:20
5384.text: that his heart may not exalt itself above his brothers and that he may not turn aside from the commandment to the right or to the left, in order that he may lengthen his days upon his kingdom, he and his sons in the midst of Israel.

5385.label: Deuteronomy 18:1
5385.text: “No share or inheritance with Israel should come to belong to the priests, the Levites, the entire tribe of Leʹvi. The offerings made by fire of Jehovah, even his inheritance, they should eat.

5386.label: Deuteronomy 18:2
5386.text: So no inheritance should come to belong to him in the midst of his brothers. Jehovah is his inheritance, just as he has spoken to him.

5387.label: Deuteronomy 18:3
5387.text: “Now this should continue as the due right of the priests from the people, from the ones who sacrifice a victim, whether a bull or a sheep: One must give to the priest the shoulder blade and the jaws and the stomach.

5388.label: Deuteronomy 18:4
5388.text: The first of your grain, your new wine and your oil and the first of the shorn wool of your flock you should give him.

5389.label: Deuteronomy 18:5
5389.text: For he is the one whom Jehovah your God has chosen out of all your tribes to stand to minister in the name of Jehovah, he and his sons, always.

5390.label: Deuteronomy 18:6
5390.text: “And in case the Levite goes out of one of your cities of all Israel, where he had resided for a while, and he does come because of any craving of his soul to the place that Jehovah will choose,

5391.label: Deuteronomy 18:7
5391.text: he must also minister in the name of Jehovah his God the same as all his brothers, the Levites, who are standing there before Jehovah.

5392.label: Deuteronomy 18:8
5392.text: An equal share he should eat, besides what he gets from things he sells of his ancestral goods.

5393.label: Deuteronomy 18:9
5393.text: “When you are entered into the land that Jehovah your God is giving you, you must not learn to do according to the detestable things of those nations.

5394.label: Deuteronomy 18:10
5394.text: There should not be found in you anyone who makes his son or his daughter pass through the fire, anyone who employs divination, a practicer of magic or anyone who looks for omens or a sorcerer,

5395.label: Deuteronomy 18:11
5395.text: or one who binds others with a spell or anyone who consults a spirit medium or a professional foreteller of events or anyone who inquires of the dead.

5396.label: Deuteronomy 18:12
5396.text: For everybody doing these things is something detestable to Jehovah, and on account of these detestable things Jehovah your God is driving them away from before you.

5397.label: Deuteronomy 18:13
5397.text: You should prove yourself faultless with Jehovah your God.

5398.label: Deuteronomy 18:14
5398.text: “For these nations whom you are dispossessing used to listen to those practicing magic and to those who divine; but as for you, Jehovah your God has not given you anything like this.

5399.label: Deuteronomy 18:15
5399.text: A prophet from your own midst, from your brothers, like me, is what Jehovah your God will raise up for you—to him YOU people should listen —

5400.label: Deuteronomy 18:16
5400.text: in response to all that you asked of Jehovah your God in Hoʹreb on the day of the congregation, saying, ‘Do not let me hear again the voice of Jehovah my God, and this great fire do not let me see anymore, that I may not die.’

5401.label: Deuteronomy 18:17
5401.text: At that Jehovah said to me, ‘They have done well in speaking what they did.

5402.label: Deuteronomy 18:18
5402.text: A prophet I shall raise up for them from the midst of their brothers, like you; and I shall indeed put my words in his mouth, and he will certainly speak to them all that I shall command him.

5403.label: Deuteronomy 18:19
5403.text: And it must occur that the man who will not listen to my words that he will speak in my name, I shall myself require an account from him.

5404.label: Deuteronomy 18:20
5404.text: “‘However, the prophet who presumes to speak in my name a word that I have not commanded him to speak or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet must die.

5405.label: Deuteronomy 18:21
5405.text: And in case you should say in your heart: “How shall we know the word that Jehovah has not spoken?”

5406.label: Deuteronomy 18:22
5406.text: when the prophet speaks in the name of Jehovah and the word does not occur or come true, that is the word that Jehovah did not speak. With presumptuousness the prophet spoke it. You must not get frightened at him.’

5407.label: Deuteronomy 19:1
5407.text: “When Jehovah your God cuts off the nations whose land Jehovah your God is giving you, and you have dispossessed them and have dwelt in their cities and their houses,

5408.label: Deuteronomy 19:2
5408.text: you will set apart three cities for yourself in the midst of your land that Jehovah your God is giving you to take possession of it.

5409.label: Deuteronomy 19:3
5409.text: You will prepare for yourself the way, and you must divide up the territory of your land that Jehovah your God proceeded to give you as a possession into three parts, and it must be for any manslayer to flee there.

5410.label: Deuteronomy 19:4
5410.text: “Now this is the case of the manslayer who may flee there and has to live: When he strikes his fellowman without knowing it and he was no hater of him formerly;

5411.label: Deuteronomy 19:5
5411.text: or when he goes with his fellowman into the woods to gather wood, and his hand has been raised to strike with the ax to cut the tree, and the iron has slipped off from the wooden handle, and it has hit his fellowman and he has died, he himself should flee to one of these cities and must live.

5412.label: Deuteronomy 19:6
5412.text: Otherwise, the avenger of blood may, because his heart is hot, chase after the manslayer and actually overtake him, since the way is great; and he may indeed strike his soul fatally, whereas there is no sentence of death for him, because he was no hater of him formerly.

5413.label: Deuteronomy 19:7
5413.text: That is why I am commanding you, saying, ‘Three cities you will set apart for yourself.’

5414.label: Deuteronomy 19:8
5414.text: “And if Jehovah your God widens out your territory according to what he swore to your forefathers, and he has given you all the land that he promised to give to your forefathers,

5415.label: Deuteronomy 19:9
5415.text: because you will keep all this commandment that I am commanding you today by doing it, to love Jehovah your God and to walk in his ways always, you must then add three other cities for yourself to these three,

5416.label: Deuteronomy 19:10
5416.text: that no innocent blood may be spilled in the midst of your land that Jehovah your God is giving you as an inheritance, and no bloodguilt has to be upon you.

5417.label: Deuteronomy 19:11
5417.text: “But in case there should happen to be a man hating his fellowman, and he has lain in wait for him and has risen up against him and struck his soul fatally and he has died, and the man has fled to one of these cities,

5418.label: Deuteronomy 19:12
5418.text: the older men of his city must then send and take him from there, and they must deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, and he must die.

5419.label: Deuteronomy 19:13
5419.text: Your eye should not feel sorry for him, and you must clear away the guilt of innocent blood out of Israel, that you may have good.

5420.label: Deuteronomy 19:14
5420.text: “You must not move back the boundary marks of your fellowman, when the ancestors will have set the boundaries in your inheritance that you will inherit in the land that Jehovah your God is giving you to take possession of it.

5421.label: Deuteronomy 19:15
5421.text: “No single witness should rise up against a man respecting any error or any sin, in the case of any sin that he may commit. At the mouth of two witnesses or at the mouth of three witnesses the matter should stand good.

5422.label: Deuteronomy 19:16
5422.text: In case a witness scheming violence should rise up against a man to bring a charge of revolt against him,

5423.label: Deuteronomy 19:17
5423.text: the two men who have the dispute must also stand before Jehovah, before the priests and the judges who will be acting in those days.

5424.label: Deuteronomy 19:18
5424.text: And the judges must search thoroughly, and if the witness is a false witness and has brought a false charge against his brother,

5425.label: Deuteronomy 19:19
5425.text: YOU must also do to him just as he had schemed to do to his brother, and you must clear away what is bad from your midst.

5426.label: Deuteronomy 19:20
5426.text: So those who remain will hear and be afraid, and they will never again do anything bad like this in your midst.

5427.label: Deuteronomy 19:21
5427.text: And your eye should not feel sorry: soul will be for soul, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

5428.label: Deuteronomy 20:1
5428.text: “In case you go out to the battle against your enemies and you actually see horses and war chariots, a people more numerous than you, you must not be afraid of them; for Jehovah your God is with you, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

5429.label: Deuteronomy 20:2
5429.text: And it must occur that when YOU have drawn near to the battle, the priest must also approach and speak to the people.

5430.label: Deuteronomy 20:3
5430.text: And he must say to them, ‘Hear, O Israel, YOU are drawing near today to the battle against YOUR enemies. Do not let YOUR hearts be timid. Do not be afraid and run in panic or shudder because of them,

5431.label: Deuteronomy 20:4
5431.text: for Jehovah YOUR God is marching with YOU to fight for YOU against YOUR enemies so as to save YOU.’

5432.label: Deuteronomy 20:5
5432.text: “The officers too must speak to the people, saying, ‘Who is the man that has built a new house and has not inaugurated it? Let him go and return to his house, for fear he may die in the battle and another man should inaugurate it.

5433.label: Deuteronomy 20:6
5433.text: And who is the man that has planted a vineyard and not begun to use it? Let him go and return to his house, for fear he may die in the battle and another man should begin to use it.

5434.label: Deuteronomy 20:7
5434.text: And who is the man that has become engaged to a woman and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, for fear he may die in the battle and another man should take her.’

5435.label: Deuteronomy 20:8
5435.text: And the officers must speak further to the people and say, ‘Who is the man that is fearful and fainthearted? Let him go and return to his house, that he may not cause the hearts of his brothers to melt as his own heart.’

5436.label: Deuteronomy 20:9
5436.text: And it must occur that when the officers have finished speaking to the people, they must also appoint chiefs of the armies at the head of the people.

5437.label: Deuteronomy 20:10
5437.text: “In case you draw near to a city to fight against it, you must also announce to it terms of peace.

5438.label: Deuteronomy 20:11
5438.text: And it must occur that if it gives a peaceful answer to you and it has opened up to you, it must even occur that all the people found in it should become yours for forced labor, and they must serve you.

5439.label: Deuteronomy 20:12
5439.text: But if it does not make peace with you, and it actually makes war with you and you have to besiege it,

5440.label: Deuteronomy 20:13
5440.text: Jehovah your God also will certainly give it into your hand, and you must strike every male in it with the edge of the sword.

5441.label: Deuteronomy 20:14
5441.text: Only the women and the little children and the domestic animals and everything that happens to be in the city, all its spoil you will plunder for yourself; and you must eat the spoil of your enemies, whom Jehovah your God has given to you.

5442.label: Deuteronomy 20:15
5442.text: “That is the way you will do to all the cities very far away from you that are not of the cities of these nations.

5443.label: Deuteronomy 20:16
5443.text: It is only of the cities of these peoples that Jehovah your God is giving you as an inheritance that you must not preserve any breathing thing alive,

5444.label: Deuteronomy 20:17
5444.text: because you should without fail devote them to destruction, the Hitʹtites and the Amʹor·ites, the Caʹnaan·ites and the Perʹiz·zites, the Hiʹvites and the Jebʹu·sites, just as Jehovah your God has commanded you;

5445.label: Deuteronomy 20:18
5445.text: in order that they may not teach YOU to do according to all their detestable things, which they have done to their gods, and YOU may indeed sin against Jehovah YOUR God.

5446.label: Deuteronomy 20:19
5446.text: “In case you lay siege to a city many days by fighting against it so as to capture it, you must not ruin its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you should eat from them, and you must not cut them down, for is the tree of the field a man to be besieged by you?

5447.label: Deuteronomy 20:20
5447.text: Only a tree that you know is not a tree for food, it is the one you should ruin, and you must cut it down and build siegeworks against the city that is making war with you, until it falls.

5448.label: Deuteronomy 21:1
5448.text: “In case someone is found slain on the ground that Jehovah your God is giving you to take possession of it, fallen on the field, and it has not become known who struck him fatally,

5449.label: Deuteronomy 21:2
5449.text: your older men and your judges must also go out and measure to the cities that are all around the slain one;

5450.label: Deuteronomy 21:3
5450.text: and it must prove to be the city nearest to the slain one. And the older men of that city must take a young cow of the herd that has not been worked with, that has not pulled in a yoke;

5451.label: Deuteronomy 21:4
5451.text: and the older men of that city must lead the young cow down to a torrent valley running with water in which there was customarily no tilling or sowing of seed, and they must break the neck of the young cow there in the torrent valley.

5452.label: Deuteronomy 21:5
5452.text: “And the priests the sons of Leʹvi must approach, because they are the ones Jehovah your God has chosen to minister to him and to bless in the name of Jehovah and at whose mouth every dispute over every violent deed should be disposed of.

5453.label: Deuteronomy 21:6
5453.text: Then all the older men of that city who are nearest to the slain one should wash their hands over the young cow, the neck of which was broken in the torrent valley;

5454.label: Deuteronomy 21:7
5454.text: and they must answer and say, ‘Our hands did not shed this blood, neither did our eyes see [it shed].

5455.label: Deuteronomy 21:8
5455.text: Do not set it to the account of your people Israel, whom you redeemed, O Jehovah, and do not put the guilt of innocent blood in the midst of your people Israel.’ And the bloodguilt must not be set to their account.

5456.label: Deuteronomy 21:9
5456.text: And you—you will clear away the guilt of innocent blood from your midst, because you will do what is right in Jehovah’s eyes.

5457.label: Deuteronomy 21:10
5457.text: “In case you go out to the battle against your enemies and Jehovah your God has given them into your hand and you have carried them away captive;

5458.label: Deuteronomy 21:11
5458.text: and you have seen among the captives a woman beautiful in form, and you have got attached to her and taken her for your wife,

5459.label: Deuteronomy 21:12
5459.text: you must then bring her into the midst of your house. She must now shave her head and attend to her nails,

5460.label: Deuteronomy 21:13
5460.text: and remove the mantle of her captivity from off her and dwell in your house and weep for her father and her mother a whole lunar month; and after that you should have relations with her, and you must take possession of her as your bride, and she must become your wife.

5461.label: Deuteronomy 21:14
5461.text: And it must occur that if you have found no delight in her, you must then send her away, agreeably to her own soul; but you must by no means sell her for money. You must not deal tyrannically with her after you have humiliated her.

5462.label: Deuteronomy 21:15
5462.text: “In case a man comes to have two wives, the one loved and the other hated, and they, the loved one and the hated one, have borne sons to him, and the firstborn son has come to be of the hated one,

5463.label: Deuteronomy 21:16
5463.text: it must also occur that in the day that he gives as an inheritance to his sons what he happens to have, he will not be allowed to constitute the son of the loved one his firstborn at the expense of the hated one’s son, the firstborn.

5464.label: Deuteronomy 21:17
5464.text: For he should recognize as the firstborn the hated one’s son by giving him two parts in everything he is found to have, because that one is the beginning of his generative power. The right of the firstborn’s position belongs to him.

5465.label: Deuteronomy 21:18
5465.text: “In case a man happens to have a son who is stubborn and rebellious, he not listening to the voice of his father or the voice of his mother, and they have corrected him but he will not listen to them,

5466.label: Deuteronomy 21:19
5466.text: his father and his mother must also take hold of him and bring him out to the older men of his city and to the gate of his place,

5467.label: Deuteronomy 21:20
5467.text: and they must say to the older men of his city, ‘This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious; he is not listening to our voice, being a glutton and a drunkard.’

5468.label: Deuteronomy 21:21
5468.text: Then all the men of his city must pelt him with stones, and he must die. So you must clear away what is bad from your midst, and all Israel will hear and indeed become afraid.

5469.label: Deuteronomy 21:22
5469.text: “And in case there comes to be in a man a sin deserving the sentence of death, and he has been put to death, and you have hung him upon a stake,

5470.label: Deuteronomy 21:23
5470.text: his dead body should not stay all night on the stake; but you should by all means bury him on that day, because something accursed of God is the one hung up; and you must not defile your soil, which Jehovah your God is giving you as an inheritance.

5471.label: Deuteronomy 22:1
5471.text: “You must not see the bull of your brother or his sheep straying about and deliberately withdraw from them. You should by all means lead them back to your brother.

5472.label: Deuteronomy 22:2
5472.text: And if your brother is not near you and you have not got to know him, you must also bring it home into the midst of your house, and it must continue with you until your brother has searched for it. And you must return it to him.

5473.label: Deuteronomy 22:3
5473.text: That is the way too that you will do with his ass, and that is the way you will do with his mantle, and that is the way you will do with anything lost of your brother’s, which gets lost from him and which you have found. You will not be allowed to withdraw yourself.

5474.label: Deuteronomy 22:4
5474.text: “You must not see the ass of your brother or his bull fall down on the road and deliberately withdraw from them. You should by all means help him raise them up.

5475.label: Deuteronomy 22:5
5475.text: “No garb of an able-bodied man should be put upon a woman, neither should an able-bodied man wear the mantle of a woman; for anybody doing these things is something detestable to Jehovah your God.

5476.label: Deuteronomy 22:6
5476.text: “In case a bird’s nest happens to be before you in the way, in any tree or on the earth with young ones or eggs, and the mother is sitting upon the young ones or the eggs, you must not take the mother along with the offspring.

5477.label: Deuteronomy 22:7
5477.text: You should by all means send the mother away, but you may take the offspring for yourself; in order that it may go well with you, and you may indeed lengthen your days.

5478.label: Deuteronomy 22:8
5478.text: “In case you build a new house, you must also make a parapet for your roof, that you may not place bloodguilt upon your house because someone falling might fall from it.

5479.label: Deuteronomy 22:9
5479.text: “You must not sow your vineyard with two sorts of seed, for fear that the full produce of the seed that you might sow and the product of the vineyard may be forfeited to the sanctuary.

5480.label: Deuteronomy 22:10
5480.text: “You must not plow with a bull and an ass together.

5481.label: Deuteronomy 22:11
5481.text: “You must not wear mixed stuff of wool and linen together.

5482.label: Deuteronomy 22:12
5482.text: “You should make tassels for yourself on the four extremities of your clothing with which you cover yourself.

5483.label: Deuteronomy 22:13
5483.text: “In case a man takes a wife and actually has relations with her and has come to hate her,

5484.label: Deuteronomy 22:14
5484.text: and he has charged her with notorious deeds and brought forth a bad name upon her and has said, ‘This is the woman I have taken, and I proceeded to go near her, and I did not find evidence of virginity in her’;

5485.label: Deuteronomy 22:15
5485.text: the father of the girl and her mother must also take and bring forth the evidence of the girl’s virginity to the older men of the city at the gate of it;

5486.label: Deuteronomy 22:16
5486.text: and the girl’s father must say to the older men, ‘I gave my daughter to this man as a wife, and he went hating her.

5487.label: Deuteronomy 22:17
5487.text: And here he is charging her with notorious deeds, saying: “I have found your daughter does not have evidence of virginity.” Now this is the evidence of my daughter’s virginity.’ And they must spread out the mantle before the older men of the city.

5488.label: Deuteronomy 22:18
5488.text: And the older men of that city must take the man and discipline him.

5489.label: Deuteronomy 22:19
5489.text: And they must fine him a hundred silver shekels and give them to the girl’s father, because he brought forth a bad name upon a virgin of Israel; and she will continue to be his wife. He will not be allowed to divorce her all his days.

5490.label: Deuteronomy 22:20
5490.text: “If, though, this thing has proved to be the truth, evidence of virginity was not found in the girl,

5491.label: Deuteronomy 22:21
5491.text: they must also bring the girl out to the entrance of her father’s house, and the men of her city must pelt her with stones, and she must die, because she has committed a disgraceful folly in Israel by committing prostitution in the house of her father. So you must clear away what is bad from your midst.

5492.label: Deuteronomy 22:22
5492.text: “In case a man is found lying down with a woman owned by an owner, both of them must then die together, the man lying down with the woman and the woman. So you must clear away what is bad out of Israel.

5493.label: Deuteronomy 22:23
5493.text: “In case there happened to be a virgin girl engaged to a man, and a man actually found her in the city and lay down with her,

5494.label: Deuteronomy 22:24
5494.text: YOU must also bring them both out to the gate of that city and pelt them with stones, and they must die, the girl for the reason that she did not scream in the city, and the man for the reason that he humiliated the wife of his fellowman. So you must clear away what is evil from your midst.

5495.label: Deuteronomy 22:25
5495.text: “If, however, it is in the field that the man found the girl who was engaged, and the man grabbed hold of her and lay down with her, the man who lay down with her must also die by himself,

5496.label: Deuteronomy 22:26
5496.text: and to the girl you must do nothing. The girl has no sin deserving of death, because just as when a man rises up against his fellowman and indeed murders him, even a soul, so it is with this case.

5497.label: Deuteronomy 22:27
5497.text: For it was in the field that he found her. The girl who was engaged screamed, but there was no one to rescue her.

5498.label: Deuteronomy 22:28
5498.text: “In case a man finds a girl, a virgin who has not been engaged, and he actually seizes her and lies down with her, and they have been found out,

5499.label: Deuteronomy 22:29
5499.text: the man who lay down with her must also give the girl’s father fifty silver shekels, and she will become his wife due to the fact that he humiliated her. He will not be allowed to divorce her all his days.

5500.label: Deuteronomy 22:30
5500.text: “No man should take his father’s wife, that he may not uncover the skirt of his father.

5501.label: Deuteronomy 23:1
5501.text: “No man castrated by crushing the testicles or having his male member cut off may come into the congregation of Jehovah.

5502.label: Deuteronomy 23:2
5502.text: “No illegitimate son may come into the congregation of Jehovah. Even to the tenth generation none of his may come into the congregation of Jehovah.

5503.label: Deuteronomy 23:3
5503.text: “No Amʹmon·ite or Moʹab·ite may come into the congregation of Jehovah. Even to the tenth generation none of theirs may come into the congregation of Jehovah to time indefinite,

5504.label: Deuteronomy 23:4
5504.text: for the reason that they did not come to YOUR aid with bread and water in the way when YOU were going out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Baʹlaam the son of Beʹor from Peʹthor of Mes·o·po·taʹmi·a to call down evil upon you.

5505.label: Deuteronomy 23:5
5505.text: And Jehovah your God did not want to listen to Baʹlaam; but Jehovah your God in your behalf changed the malediction into a blessing, because Jehovah your God loved you.

5506.label: Deuteronomy 23:6
5506.text: You must not work for their peace and their prosperity all your days to time indefinite.

5507.label: Deuteronomy 23:7
5507.text: “You must not detest an Eʹdom·ite, for he is your brother. “You must not detest an Egyptian, for you became an alien resident in his country.

5508.label: Deuteronomy 23:8
5508.text: The sons that may be born to them as the third generation may come for themselves into the congregation of Jehovah.

5509.label: Deuteronomy 23:9
5509.text: “In case you go out into camp against your enemies, you must also keep yourself from every bad thing.

5510.label: Deuteronomy 23:10
5510.text: In case there happens to be in you a man who does not continue clean, because of a pollution that occurs at night, he must also go outside the camp. He may not come into the midst of the camp.

5511.label: Deuteronomy 23:11
5511.text: And it must occur that at the falling of evening he should wash with water, and at the setting of the sun he may come into the midst of the camp.

5512.label: Deuteronomy 23:12
5512.text: And a private place should be at your service outside the camp, and you must go out there.

5513.label: Deuteronomy 23:13
5513.text: And a peg should be at your service along with your implements, and it must occur that when you squat outside, you must also dig a hole with it and turn and cover your excrement.

5514.label: Deuteronomy 23:14
5514.text: For Jehovah your God is walking about within your camp to deliver you and to abandon your enemies to you; and your camp must prove to be holy, that he may see nothing indecent in you and certainly turn away from accompanying you.

5515.label: Deuteronomy 23:15
5515.text: “You must not hand over a slave to his master when he escapes from his master to you.

5516.label: Deuteronomy 23:16
5516.text: With you he will keep on dwelling in among you in whatever place he may choose in one of your cities, wherever he likes. You must not maltreat him.

5517.label: Deuteronomy 23:17
5517.text: “None of the daughters of Israel may become a temple prostitute, neither may anyone of the sons of Israel become a temple prostitute.

5518.label: Deuteronomy 23:18
5518.text: You must not bring the hire of a harlot or the price of a dog into the house of Jehovah your God for any vow, because they are something detestable to Jehovah your God, even both of them.

5519.label: Deuteronomy 23:19
5519.text: “You must not make your brother pay interest, interest on money, interest on food, interest on anything on which one may claim interest.

5520.label: Deuteronomy 23:20
5520.text: You may make a foreigner pay interest, but your brother you must not make pay interest; in order that Jehovah your God may bless you in every undertaking of yours on the land to which you are going so as to take possession of it.

5521.label: Deuteronomy 23:21
5521.text: “In case you vow a vow to Jehovah your God, you must not be slow about paying it, because Jehovah your God will without fail require it of you, and it would indeed become a sin on your part.

5522.label: Deuteronomy 23:22
5522.text: But in case you omit making a vow, it will not become a sin on your part.

5523.label: Deuteronomy 23:23
5523.text: The utterance of your lips you should keep, and you must do just as you have vowed to Jehovah your God as a voluntary offering that you spoke of with your mouth.

5524.label: Deuteronomy 23:24
5524.text: “In case you go into the vineyard of your fellowman, you must eat only enough grapes for you to satisfy your soul, but you must not put any into a receptacle of yours.

5525.label: Deuteronomy 23:25
5525.text: “In case you go into the standing grain of your fellowman, you must pluck off only the ripe ears with your hand, but the sickle you must not swing to and fro upon the standing grain of your fellowman.

5526.label: Deuteronomy 24:1
5526.text: “In case a man takes a woman and does make her his possession as a wife, it must also occur that if she should find no favor in his eyes because he has found something indecent on her part, he must also write out a certificate of divorce for her and put it in her hand and dismiss her from his house.

5527.label: Deuteronomy 24:2
5527.text: And she must go out of his house and go and become another man’s.

5528.label: Deuteronomy 24:3
5528.text: If the latter man has come to hate her and has written out a certificate of divorce for her and put it in her hand and dismissed her from his house, or in case the latter man who took her as his wife should die,

5529.label: Deuteronomy 24:4
5529.text: the first owner of her who dismissed her will not be allowed to take her back again to become his wife after she has been defiled; for that is something detestable before Jehovah, and you must not lead the land that Jehovah your God is giving you as an inheritance into sin.

5530.label: Deuteronomy 24:5
5530.text: “In case a man takes a new wife, he should not go out into the army, nor should anything else be imposed onto him. He should continue exempt at his house for one year, and he must make his wife whom he has taken rejoice.

5531.label: Deuteronomy 24:6
5531.text: “No one should seize a hand mill or its upper grindstone as a pledge, because it is a soul that he is seizing as a pledge.

5532.label: Deuteronomy 24:7
5532.text: “In case a man is found kidnapping a soul of his brothers of the sons of Israel, and he has dealt tyrannically with him and sold him, that kidnapper must also die. And you must clear away what is bad from your midst.

5533.label: Deuteronomy 24:8
5533.text: “Be on your guard in the plague of leprosy to take good care and do according to all that the priests, the Levites, will instruct YOU. Just as I have commanded them, YOU should be careful to do.

5534.label: Deuteronomy 24:9
5534.text: There should be a remembering of what Jehovah your God did to Mirʹi·am in the way when YOU were coming out of Egypt.

5535.label: Deuteronomy 24:10
5535.text: “In case you lend your fellowman a loan of any sort, you must not enter into his house to take from him what he has pledged.

5536.label: Deuteronomy 24:11
5536.text: You should stand on the outside, and the man to whom you are making a loan should bring the pledge outside to you.

5537.label: Deuteronomy 24:12
5537.text: And if the man is in trouble, you must not go to bed with his pledge.

5538.label: Deuteronomy 24:13
5538.text: You should by all means return the pledge to him as soon as the sun sets, and he must go to bed in his garment, and he must bless you; and it will mean righteousness for you before Jehovah your God.

5539.label: Deuteronomy 24:14
5539.text: “You must not defraud a hired laborer who is in trouble and poor, whether of your brothers or of your alien residents who are in your land, within your gates.

5540.label: Deuteronomy 24:15
5540.text: In his day you should give him his wages, and the sun should not set upon them, because he is in trouble and is lifting up his soul to his wages; that he may not cry out to Jehovah against you, and it must become sin on your part.

5541.label: Deuteronomy 24:16
5541.text: “Fathers should not be put to death on account of children, and children should not be put to death on account of fathers. Each one should be put to death for his own sin.

5542.label: Deuteronomy 24:17
5542.text: “You must not pervert the judgment of the alien resident or of the fatherless boy, and you must not seize the garment of a widow as a pledge.

5543.label: Deuteronomy 24:18
5543.text: And you must remember that you became a slave in Egypt, and Jehovah your God proceeded to redeem you from there. That is why I am commanding you to do this thing.

5544.label: Deuteronomy 24:19
5544.text: “In case you reap your harvest in your field, and you have forgotten a sheaf in the field, you must not go back to get it. It should stay for the alien resident, for the fatherless boy and for the widow; in order that Jehovah your God may bless you in every deed of your hand.

5545.label: Deuteronomy 24:20
5545.text: “In case you beat your olive tree, you must not go over its boughs following up yourself. It should stay for the alien resident, for the fatherless boy and for the widow.

5546.label: Deuteronomy 24:21
5546.text: “In case you gather the grapes of your vineyard, you must not gather the leftovers following up yourself. They should stay for the alien resident, for the fatherless boy and for the widow.

5547.label: Deuteronomy 24:22
5547.text: And you must remember that you became a slave in the land of Egypt. That is why I am commanding you to do this thing.

5548.label: Deuteronomy 25:1
5548.text: “In case a dispute arises between men, and they have presented themselves for the judgment, they must also judge them and pronounce the righteous one righteous and pronounce the wicked one wicked.

5549.label: Deuteronomy 25:2
5549.text: And it must occur that if the wicked one deserves to be beaten, the judge must also have him laid prostrate and given strokes before him by number to correspond with his wicked deed.

5550.label: Deuteronomy 25:3
5550.text: With forty strokes he may beat him. He should add none, for fear he should continue to beat him with many strokes in addition to these and your brother is actually disgraced in your eyes.

5551.label: Deuteronomy 25:4
5551.text: “You must not muzzle a bull while it is threshing.

5552.label: Deuteronomy 25:5
5552.text: “In case brothers dwell together and one of them has died without his having a son, the wife of the dead one should not become a strange man’s outside. Her brother-in-law should go to her, and he must take her as his wife and perform brother-in-law marriage with her.

5553.label: Deuteronomy 25:6
5553.text: And it must occur that the firstborn whom she will bear should succeed to the name of his dead brother, that his name may not be wiped out of Israel.

5554.label: Deuteronomy 25:7
5554.text: “Now if the man finds no delight in taking his brother’s widow, his brother’s widow must then go up to the gate to the older men and say, ‘My husband’s brother has refused to preserve his brother’s name in Israel. He has not consented to perform brother-in-law marriage with me.’

5555.label: Deuteronomy 25:8
5555.text: And the older men of his city must call him and speak to him, and he must stand and say, ‘I have found no delight in taking her.’

5556.label: Deuteronomy 25:9
5556.text: At that his brother’s widow must approach him before the eyes of the older men and draw his sandal off his foot and spit in his face and answer and say, ‘That is the way it should be done to the man who will not build up his brother’s household.’

5557.label: Deuteronomy 25:10
5557.text: And his name must be called in Israel ‘The house of the one who had his sandal drawn off.’

5558.label: Deuteronomy 25:11
5558.text: “In case men struggle together with one another, and the wife of the one has come near to deliver her husband out of the hand of the one striking him, and she has thrust out her hand and grabbed hold of him by his privates,

5559.label: Deuteronomy 25:12
5559.text: you must then amputate her hand. Your eye must feel no sorrow.

5560.label: Deuteronomy 25:13
5560.text: “You must not come to have in your bag two sorts of weights, a great one and a small one.

5561.label: Deuteronomy 25:14
5561.text: You must not come to have in your house two sorts of eʹphahs, a great one and a small one.

5562.label: Deuteronomy 25:15
5562.text: A weight accurate and just you should continue to have. An eʹphah accurate and just you should continue to have, in order that your days may become long on the soil that Jehovah your God is giving you.

5563.label: Deuteronomy 25:16
5563.text: For everyone doing these things, every doer of injustice, is something detestable to Jehovah your God.

5564.label: Deuteronomy 25:17
5564.text: “There should be a remembering of what Amʹa·lek did to you in the way when YOU were coming out of Egypt,

5565.label: Deuteronomy 25:18
5565.text: how he met you in the way and proceeded to strike in the rear of you all those straggling after you, while you were exhausted and weary; and he did not fear God.

5566.label: Deuteronomy 25:19
5566.text: And it must occur that when Jehovah your God has given you rest from all your enemies round about in the land that Jehovah your God is giving you as an inheritance to take possession of it, you should wipe out the mention of Amʹa·lek from under the heavens. You must not forget.

5567.label: Deuteronomy 26:1
5567.text: “And it must occur that when at last you enter into the land that Jehovah your God is giving you as an inheritance, and you have taken possession of it and dwelt in it,

5568.label: Deuteronomy 26:2
5568.text: you must also take some of the firstfruits of all the fruitage of the soil, which you will bring in from the land of yours that Jehovah your God is giving you, and you must put them in a basket and go to the place that Jehovah your God will choose to have his name reside there.

5569.label: Deuteronomy 26:3
5569.text: And you must come to the priest who will be acting in those days and say to him, ‘I must report today to Jehovah your God that I have come into the land that Jehovah swore to our forefathers to give to us.’

5570.label: Deuteronomy 26:4
5570.text: “And the priest must take the basket out of your hand and deposit it before the altar of Jehovah your God.

5571.label: Deuteronomy 26:5
5571.text: And you must answer and say before Jehovah your God, ‘My father was a perishing Syrian; and he proceeded to go down to Egypt and to reside there as an alien with very few in number; but there he became a great nation, mighty and numerous.

5572.label: Deuteronomy 26:6
5572.text: And the Egyptians went treating us badly and afflicting us and putting hard slavery upon us.

5573.label: Deuteronomy 26:7
5573.text: And we began to cry out to Jehovah the God of our forefathers, and Jehovah proceeded to hear our voice and to look on our affliction and our trouble and our oppression.

5574.label: Deuteronomy 26:8
5574.text: Finally Jehovah brought us out of Egypt with a strong hand and an outstretched arm and with great fearsomeness and with signs and miracles.

5575.label: Deuteronomy 26:9
5575.text: Then he brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

5576.label: Deuteronomy 26:10
5576.text: And now here I have brought the firstfruits of the fruitage of the ground that Jehovah has given me.’ “You must also deposit it before Jehovah your God and bow down before Jehovah your God.

5577.label: Deuteronomy 26:11
5577.text: And you must rejoice over all the good that Jehovah your God has given you and your household, you and the Levite and the alien resident who is in your midst.

5578.label: Deuteronomy 26:12
5578.text: “When you finish with tithing the entire tenth of your produce in the third year, the year of the tenth, you must also give it to the Levite, the alien resident, the fatherless boy and the widow, and they must eat it within your gates and satisfy themselves.

5579.label: Deuteronomy 26:13
5579.text: And you must say before Jehovah your God, ‘I have cleared away what is holy from the house and I have also given it to the Levite and the alien resident, the fatherless boy and the widow, in accord with all your commandment that you have commanded me. I have not overstepped your commandments, nor have I forgotten.

5580.label: Deuteronomy 26:14
5580.text: I have not eaten of it during my mourning, nor have I removed any of it while unclean, nor have I given any of it for anyone dead. I have listened to the voice of Jehovah my God. I have done in accord with all that you have commanded me.

5581.label: Deuteronomy 26:15
5581.text: Do look down from your holy dwelling, the heavens, and bless your people Israel and the soil that you have given us, just as you swore to our forefathers, the land flowing with milk and honey.’

5582.label: Deuteronomy 26:16
5582.text: “This day Jehovah your God is commanding you to carry out these regulations and judicial decisions; and you must observe and carry them out with all your heart and all your soul.

5583.label: Deuteronomy 26:17
5583.text: Jehovah you have induced to say today that he will become your God while you walk in his ways and observe his regulations and his commandments and his judicial decisions and listen to his voice.

5584.label: Deuteronomy 26:18
5584.text: As for Jehovah, he has induced you to say today that you will become his people, a special property, just as he has promised you, and that you will observe all his commandments,

5585.label: Deuteronomy 26:19
5585.text: and that he will put you high above all the other nations that he has made, resulting in praise and reputation and beauty, while you prove yourself a people holy to Jehovah your God, just as he has promised.”

5586.label: Deuteronomy 27:1
5586.text: And Moses together with the older men of Israel went on to command the people, saying: “There should be an observing of every commandment that I am commanding YOU today.

5587.label: Deuteronomy 27:2
5587.text: And it must occur that in the day when YOU will cross the Jordan into the land that Jehovah your God is giving you, you must also set up for yourself great stones and whitewash them with lime.

5588.label: Deuteronomy 27:3
5588.text: And you must write upon them all the words of this law when you have crossed, in order that you may enter into the land that Jehovah your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, according to what Jehovah the God of your forefathers has spoken to you.

5589.label: Deuteronomy 27:4
5589.text: And it must occur that when YOU have crossed the Jordan, YOU should set up these stones, just as I am commanding YOU today, in Mount Eʹbal, and you must whitewash them with lime.

5590.label: Deuteronomy 27:5
5590.text: You must also build an altar there to Jehovah your God, an altar of stones. You must not wield an iron tool upon them.

5591.label: Deuteronomy 27:6
5591.text: With whole stones you should build the altar of Jehovah your God, and you must offer burnt offerings to Jehovah your God on it.

5592.label: Deuteronomy 27:7
5592.text: And you must sacrifice communion sacrifices and eat them there, and you must rejoice before Jehovah your God.

5593.label: Deuteronomy 27:8
5593.text: And you must write on the stones all the words of this law, making them quite clear.”

5594.label: Deuteronomy 27:9
5594.text: Then Moses and the priests, the Levites, spoke to all Israel, saying: “Keep silent and listen, O Israel. This day you have become the people of Jehovah your God.

5595.label: Deuteronomy 27:10
5595.text: And you must listen to the voice of Jehovah your God and carry out his commandments and his regulations, which I am commanding you today.”

5596.label: Deuteronomy 27:11
5596.text: And Moses went on to command the people on that day, saying:

5597.label: Deuteronomy 27:12
5597.text: “The following are the ones who will stand to bless the people on Mount Gerʹi·zim when YOU have crossed the Jordan: Simʹe·on and Leʹvi and Judah and Isʹsa·char and Joseph and Benjamin.

5598.label: Deuteronomy 27:13
5598.text: And the following are the ones who will stand for the malediction on Mount Eʹbal: Reuʹben, Gad and Ashʹer and Zebʹu·lun, Dan and Naphʹta·li.

5599.label: Deuteronomy 27:14
5599.text: And the Levites must answer and say with raised voice to every man of Israel:

5600.label: Deuteronomy 27:15
5600.text: “‘Cursed is the man who makes a carved image or a molten statue, a thing detestable to Jehovah, the manufacture of the hands of a wood-and-metal worker, and who has put it in a hiding place.’ (And all the people must answer and say, ‘Amen!’ )

5601.label: Deuteronomy 27:16
5601.text: “‘Cursed is the one who treats his father or his mother with contempt.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5602.label: Deuteronomy 27:17
5602.text: “‘Cursed is the one who moves back the boundary mark of his fellowman.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5603.label: Deuteronomy 27:18
5603.text: “‘Cursed is the one who causes the blind to go astray in the way.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5604.label: Deuteronomy 27:19
5604.text: “‘Cursed is the one who perverts the judgment of an alien resident, a fatherless boy and a widow.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5605.label: Deuteronomy 27:20
5605.text: “‘Cursed is the one who lies down with his father’s wife, because he has uncovered the skirt of his father.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5606.label: Deuteronomy 27:21
5606.text: “‘Cursed is the one who lies down with any beast.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5607.label: Deuteronomy 27:22
5607.text: “‘Cursed is the one who lies down with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5608.label: Deuteronomy 27:23
5608.text: “‘Cursed is the one who lies down with his mother-in-law.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5609.label: Deuteronomy 27:24
5609.text: “‘Cursed is the one who fatally strikes his fellowman from a hiding place.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5610.label: Deuteronomy 27:25
5610.text: “‘Cursed is the one who accepts a bribe to strike a soul fatally, when it is innocent blood.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5611.label: Deuteronomy 27:26
5611.text: “‘Cursed is the one who will not put the words of this law in force by doing them.’ (And all the people must say, ‘Amen!’)

5612.label: Deuteronomy 28:1
5612.text: “And it must occur that if you will without fail listen to the voice of Jehovah your God by being careful to do all his commandments that I am commanding you today, Jehovah your God also will certainly put you high above all other nations of the earth.

5613.label: Deuteronomy 28:2
5613.text: And all these blessings must come upon you and overtake you, because you keep listening to the voice of Jehovah your God:

5614.label: Deuteronomy 28:3
5614.text: “Blessed will you be in the city, and blessed will you be in the field.

5615.label: Deuteronomy 28:4
5615.text: “Blessed will be the fruit of your belly and the fruit of your ground and the fruit of your domestic beast, the young of your cattle and the progeny of your flock.

5616.label: Deuteronomy 28:5
5616.text: “Blessed will be your basket and your kneading trough.

5617.label: Deuteronomy 28:6
5617.text: “Blessed will you be when you come in, and blessed will you be when you go out.

5618.label: Deuteronomy 28:7
5618.text: “Jehovah will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you. By one way they will come out against you, but by seven ways they will flee before you.

5619.label: Deuteronomy 28:8
5619.text: Jehovah will decree for you the blessing on your stores of supply and every undertaking of yours, and he will certainly bless you in the land that Jehovah your God is giving you.

5620.label: Deuteronomy 28:9
5620.text: Jehovah will establish you as a holy people to himself, just as he swore to you, because you continue to keep the commandments of Jehovah your God, and you have walked in his ways.

5621.label: Deuteronomy 28:10
5621.text: And all the peoples of the earth will have to see that Jehovah’s name has been called upon you, and they will indeed be afraid of you.

5622.label: Deuteronomy 28:11
5622.text: “Jehovah will also make you overflow indeed with prosperity in the fruit of your belly and the fruit of your domestic animals and the fruitage of your ground, on the ground that Jehovah swore to your forefathers to give you.

5623.label: Deuteronomy 28:12
5623.text: Jehovah will open up to you his good storehouse, the heavens, to give the rain on your land in its season and to bless every deed of your hand; and you will certainly lend to many nations, while you yourself will not borrow.

5624.label: Deuteronomy 28:13
5624.text: And Jehovah will indeed put you at the head and not at the tail; and you must come to be only on top, and you will not come to be on the bottom, because you keep obeying the commandments of Jehovah your God, which I am commanding you today to observe and to do.

5625.label: Deuteronomy 28:14
5625.text: And you must not turn aside from all the words that I am commanding YOU today, to the right or to the left, to walk after other gods to serve them.

5626.label: Deuteronomy 28:15
5626.text: “And it must occur that if you will not listen to the voice of Jehovah your God by taking care to do all his commandments and his statutes that I am commanding you today, all these maledictions must also come upon you and overtake you:

5627.label: Deuteronomy 28:16
5627.text: “Cursed will you be in the city, and cursed will you be in the field.

5628.label: Deuteronomy 28:17
5628.text: “Cursed will be your basket and your kneading trough.

5629.label: Deuteronomy 28:18
5629.text: “Cursed will be the fruit of your belly and the fruitage of your ground, the young of your cattle and the progeny of your flock.

5630.label: Deuteronomy 28:19
5630.text: “Cursed will you be when you come in, and cursed will you be when you go out.

5631.label: Deuteronomy 28:20
5631.text: “Jehovah will send upon you the curse, confusion and rebuke in every undertaking of yours that you try to carry out, until you have been annihilated and have perished in a hurry, because of the badness of your practices in that you have forsaken me.

5632.label: Deuteronomy 28:21
5632.text: Jehovah will cause the pestilence to cling to you until he has exterminated you from off the ground to which you are going to take possession of it.

5633.label: Deuteronomy 28:22
5633.text: Jehovah will strike you with tuberculosis and burning fever and inflammation and feverish heat and the sword and scorching and mildew, and they will certainly pursue you until you have perished.

5634.label: Deuteronomy 28:23
5634.text: Your skies that are over your head must also become copper, and the earth that is beneath you iron.

5635.label: Deuteronomy 28:24
5635.text: Jehovah will give powder and dust as the rain of your land. From the heavens it will come down upon you until you have been annihilated.

5636.label: Deuteronomy 28:25
5636.text: Jehovah will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. By one way you will go out against them, but by seven ways you will flee before them; and you must become a frightful object to all the earth’s kingdoms.

5637.label: Deuteronomy 28:26
5637.text: And your dead body must become food for every flying creature of the heavens and to the beast of the field, with no one to make [them] tremble.

5638.label: Deuteronomy 28:27
5638.text: “Jehovah will strike you with the boil of Egypt and piles and eczema and skin eruption, from which you will not be able to be healed.

5639.label: Deuteronomy 28:28
5639.text: Jehovah will strike you with madness and loss of sight and bewilderment of heart.

5640.label: Deuteronomy 28:29
5640.text: And you will indeed become one who gropes about at midday, just as a blind man gropes about in the gloom, and you will not make your ways successful; and you must become only one who is always defrauded and robbed, with no one to save you.

5641.label: Deuteronomy 28:30
5641.text: You will become engaged to a woman, but another man will rape her. You will build a house, but you will not dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not begin to use it.

5642.label: Deuteronomy 28:31
5642.text: Your bull slaughtered there before your eyes—but you will not eat any of it. Your ass taken in robbery from before your face—but it will not return to you. Your sheep given to your enemies—but you will have no savior.

5643.label: Deuteronomy 28:32
5643.text: Your sons and your daughters given to another people and your eyes looking on and yearning for them always—but your hands will be without power.

5644.label: Deuteronomy 28:33
5644.text: The fruitage of your ground and all your production a people will eat whom you have not known; and you must become one who is only defrauded and crushed always.

5645.label: Deuteronomy 28:34
5645.text: And you will certainly become maddened at the sight of your eyes that you will see.

5646.label: Deuteronomy 28:35
5646.text: “Jehovah will strike you with a malignant boil upon both knees and both legs, from which you will not be able to be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

5647.label: Deuteronomy 28:36
5647.text: Jehovah will march you and your king whom you will set up over you to a nation whom you have not known, neither you nor your forefathers; and there you will have to serve other gods, of wood and of stone.

5648.label: Deuteronomy 28:37
5648.text: And you must become an object of astonishment, a proverbial saying and a taunt among all the peoples to whom Jehovah will lead you away.

5649.label: Deuteronomy 28:38
5649.text: “A lot of seed you will take out to the field, but little will you gather, because the locust will devour it.

5650.label: Deuteronomy 28:39
5650.text: Vineyards you will plant and certainly cultivate, but you will drink no wine and gather nothing in, because the worm will eat it up.

5651.label: Deuteronomy 28:40
5651.text: You will come to have olive trees in all your territory, but you will rub yourself with no oil, because your olives will drop off.

5652.label: Deuteronomy 28:41
5652.text: Sons and daughters you will bring forth, but they will not continue yours, because they will go off into captivity.

5653.label: Deuteronomy 28:42
5653.text: All your trees and the fruitage of your ground whirring insects will take in possession.

5654.label: Deuteronomy 28:43
5654.text: The alien resident who is in your midst will keep ascending higher and higher above you, while you—you will keep descending lower and lower.

5655.label: Deuteronomy 28:44
5655.text: He will be the one to lend to you, while you—you will not lend to him. He will become the head, while you—you will become the tail.

5656.label: Deuteronomy 28:45
5656.text: “And all these maledictions will certainly come upon you and pursue you and overtake you until you have been annihilated, because you did not listen to the voice of Jehovah your God by keeping his commandments and his statutes that he commanded you.

5657.label: Deuteronomy 28:46
5657.text: And they must continue on you and your offspring as a sign and a portent to time indefinite,

5658.label: Deuteronomy 28:47
5658.text: due to the fact that you did not serve Jehovah your God with rejoicing and joy of heart for the abundance of everything.

5659.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
5659.text: And you will have to serve your enemies whom Jehovah will send against you with hunger and thirst and nakedness and the want of everything; and he will certainly put an iron yoke upon your neck until he has annihilated you.

5660.label: Deuteronomy 28:49
5660.text: “Jehovah will raise up against you a nation far away, from the end of the earth, just as an eagle pounces, a nation whose tongue you will not understand,

5661.label: Deuteronomy 28:50
5661.text: a nation fierce in countenance, who will not be partial to an old man or show favor to a young man.

5662.label: Deuteronomy 28:51
5662.text: And they will certainly eat the fruit of your domestic animals and the fruitage of your ground until you have been annihilated, and they will let no grain, new wine or oil, no young of your cattle or progeny of your flock, remain for you until they have destroyed you.

5663.label: Deuteronomy 28:52
5663.text: And they will indeed besiege you within all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you are trusting fall in all your land, yes, they will certainly besiege you within all your gates in all your land, which Jehovah your God has given you.

5664.label: Deuteronomy 28:53
5664.text: Then you will have to eat the fruit of your belly, the flesh of your sons and your daughters, whom Jehovah your God has given you, because of the tightness and stress with which your enemy will hem you in.

5665.label: Deuteronomy 28:54
5665.text: “As for the very delicate and dainty man among you, his eye will be evil-inclined toward his brother and his cherished wife and the remainder of his sons whom he has remaining,

5666.label: Deuteronomy 28:55
5666.text: so as not to give one of them any of the flesh of his sons that he will eat, because he has nothing at all remaining to him because of the tightness and stress with which your enemy will hem you in within all your gates.

5667.label: Deuteronomy 28:56
5667.text: As for the delicate and dainty woman among you who never attempted to set the sole of her foot upon the earth for being of dainty habit and for delicateness, her eye will be evil-inclined toward her cherished husband and her son and her daughter,

5668.label: Deuteronomy 28:57
