5668.text: even toward her afterbirth that comes out from between her legs and toward her sons whom she proceeded to bear, because she will eat them in secrecy for the want of everything because of the tightness and stress with which your enemy will hem you in within your gates.

5669.label: Deuteronomy 28:58
5669.text: “If you will not take care to carry out all the words of this law that are written in this book so as to fear this glorious and fear-inspiring name, even Jehovah, your God,

5670.label: Deuteronomy 28:59
5670.text: Jehovah also will certainly make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring especially severe, great and long-lasting plagues, and malignant and long-lasting sicknesses.

5671.label: Deuteronomy 28:60
5671.text: And he will indeed bring back upon you all the diseases of Egypt before which you got scared, and they will certainly hang onto you.

5672.label: Deuteronomy 28:61
5672.text: Also, any sickness and any plague that is not written in the book of this law, Jehovah will bring them upon you until you have been annihilated.

5673.label: Deuteronomy 28:62
5673.text: And YOU will indeed be left with very few in number, although YOU have become like the stars of the heavens for multitude, because you did not listen to the voice of Jehovah your God.

5674.label: Deuteronomy 28:63
5674.text: “And it must occur that just as Jehovah exulted over YOU to do YOU good and to multiply YOU, so Jehovah will exult over YOU to destroy YOU and to annihilate YOU; and YOU will simply be torn away from off the soil to which you are going to take possession of it.

5675.label: Deuteronomy 28:64
5675.text: “And Jehovah will certainly scatter you among all the peoples from the one end of the earth to the other end of the earth, and there you will have to serve other gods whom you have not known, neither you nor your forefathers, wood and stone.

5676.label: Deuteronomy 28:65
5676.text: And among those nations you will have no ease, nor will there prove to be any resting-place for the sole of your foot; and Jehovah will indeed give you there a trembling heart and a failing of the eyes and despair of soul.

5677.label: Deuteronomy 28:66
5677.text: And you will certainly be in the greatest peril for your life and be in dread night and day, and you will not be sure of your life.

5678.label: Deuteronomy 28:67
5678.text: In the morning you will say, ‘If it only were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If it only were morning!’ because of the dread of your heart with which you will be in dread and because of the sight of your eyes that you will see.

5679.label: Deuteronomy 28:68
5679.text: And Jehovah will certainly bring you back to Egypt by ships by the way about which I have said to you, ‘You will never see it again,’ and YOU will have to sell yourselves there to your enemies as slave men and maidservants, but there will be no buyer.”

5680.label: Deuteronomy 29:1
5680.text: These are the words of the covenant that Jehovah commanded Moses to conclude with the sons of Israel in the land of Moʹab aside from the covenant that he had concluded with them in Hoʹreb.

5681.label: Deuteronomy 29:2
5681.text: And Moses proceeded to call all Israel and to say to them: “YOU were the ones seeing all that Jehovah did before YOUR eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharʹaoh and all his servants and all his land,

5682.label: Deuteronomy 29:3
5682.text: the great provings that your eyes saw, those great signs and miracles.

5683.label: Deuteronomy 29:4
5683.text: And yet Jehovah has not given YOU a heart to know and eyes to see and ears to hear down to this day.

5684.label: Deuteronomy 29:5
5684.text: ‘While I kept guiding YOU forty years in the wilderness, YOUR garments did not wear out upon YOU, and your sandal did not wear out upon your foot.

5685.label: Deuteronomy 29:6
5685.text: Bread YOU did not eat, and wine and intoxicating liquor YOU did not drink, in order that YOU might know that I am Jehovah YOUR God.’

5686.label: Deuteronomy 29:7
5686.text: Eventually YOU came to this place, and Siʹhon the king of Heshʹbon and Og the king of Baʹshan proceeded to come out to meet us in battle, but we defeated them.

5687.label: Deuteronomy 29:8
5687.text: After that we took their land and gave it as an inheritance to the Reuʹben·ites and the Gadʹites and half the tribe of the Ma·nasʹsites.

5688.label: Deuteronomy 29:9
5688.text: So YOU must keep the words of this covenant and do them, in order that YOU may make everything YOU will do turn out well.

5689.label: Deuteronomy 29:10
5689.text: “YOU are all of YOU stationed today before Jehovah YOUR God, the heads of YOUR tribes, YOUR older men and YOUR officers, every man of Israel,

5690.label: Deuteronomy 29:11
5690.text: YOUR little ones, YOUR wives, and your alien resident who is in the midst of your camp, from the gatherer of your wood to the drawer of your water,

5691.label: Deuteronomy 29:12
5691.text: in order for you to enter into the covenant of Jehovah your God and his oath, which Jehovah your God is concluding with you today;

5692.label: Deuteronomy 29:13
5692.text: for the purpose of establishing you today as his people and that he may prove himself your God, just as he has promised you and just as he has sworn to your forefathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

5693.label: Deuteronomy 29:14
5693.text: “Now it is not with YOU alone that I am concluding this covenant and this oath,

5694.label: Deuteronomy 29:15
5694.text: but it is with him who is here standing with us today before Jehovah our God and with those who are not here with us today;

5695.label: Deuteronomy 29:16
5695.text: (for YOU yourselves well know how we dwelt in the land of Egypt and how we passed through the midst of the nations through whom YOU passed.

5696.label: Deuteronomy 29:17
5696.text: And YOU used to see their disgusting things and their dungy idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, that were with them;)

5697.label: Deuteronomy 29:18
5697.text: that there may not be among YOU a man or a woman or a family or a tribe whose heart is turning today away from Jehovah our God to go and serve the gods of those nations; that there may not be among YOU a root bearing the fruit of a poisonous plant and wormwood.

5698.label: Deuteronomy 29:19
5698.text: “And it must occur that when someone has heard the words of this oath, and he has blessed himself in his heart, saying, ‘I shall come to have peace, although I shall walk in the stubbornness of my heart,’ with the intention of sweeping away the well-watered one along with the thirsty ones,

5699.label: Deuteronomy 29:20
5699.text: Jehovah will not want to forgive him, but then Jehovah’s anger and his ardor will smoke against that man, and all the oath written in this book will certainly settle down on him, and Jehovah will indeed wipe out his name from under the heavens.

5700.label: Deuteronomy 29:21
5700.text: So Jehovah will have to separate him for calamity from all the tribes of Israel in accord with all the oath of the covenant that is written in this book of the law.

5701.label: Deuteronomy 29:22
5701.text: “And the future generation, YOUR sons who will rise up after YOU, will be bound to say, also the foreigner who will come from a distant land, even [when] they have seen the plagues of that land and its maladies with which Jehovah has sickened it,

5702.label: Deuteronomy 29:23
5702.text: sulphur and salt and burning, so that its whole land will not be sown, nor sprout, nor will any vegetation spring up in it, like the overthrow of Sodʹom and Go·morʹrah, Adʹmah and Ze·boiʹim, which Jehovah overthrew in his anger and in his wrath;

5703.label: Deuteronomy 29:24
5703.text: yes, all the nations will be bound to say, ‘Why did Jehovah do like this to this land? Why the heat of this great anger?’

5704.label: Deuteronomy 29:25
5704.text: Then they will have to say, ‘It was because they abandoned the covenant of Jehovah the God of their forefathers, which he concluded with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

5705.label: Deuteronomy 29:26
5705.text: And they proceeded to go and serve other gods and to bow down to them, gods that they had not known and he had not apportioned to them.

5706.label: Deuteronomy 29:27
5706.text: Then Jehovah’s anger blazed against that land by bringing upon it the whole malediction written in this book.

5707.label: Deuteronomy 29:28
5707.text: Hence Jehovah uprooted them from off their soil in anger and rage and great indignation and threw them into another land as at this day.’

5708.label: Deuteronomy 29:29
5708.text: “The things concealed belong to Jehovah our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our sons to time indefinite, that we may carry out all the words of this law.

5709.label: Deuteronomy 30:1
5709.text: “And it must occur that when all these words will come upon you, the blessing and the malediction, which I have put before you, and you have brought them back to your heart among all the nations where Jehovah your God has dispersed you,

5710.label: Deuteronomy 30:2
5710.text: and you have returned to Jehovah your God and listened to his voice according to all that I am commanding you today, you and your sons, with all your heart and all your soul,

5711.label: Deuteronomy 30:3
5711.text: Jehovah your God must also bring back your captives and show you mercy and collect you again from all the peoples where Jehovah your God has scattered you.

5712.label: Deuteronomy 30:4
5712.text: If your dispersed people should be at the end of the heavens, from there Jehovah your God will collect you and from there he will take you.

5713.label: Deuteronomy 30:5
5713.text: Jehovah your God will indeed bring you into the land of which your fathers took possession, and you will certainly take possession of it; and he will indeed do you good and multiply you more than your fathers.

5714.label: Deuteronomy 30:6
5714.text: And Jehovah your God will have to circumcise your heart and the heart of your offspring, that you may love Jehovah your God with all your heart and all your soul for the sake of your life.

5715.label: Deuteronomy 30:7
5715.text: And Jehovah your God will certainly put all these oaths upon your enemies and those who hate you, who have persecuted you.

5716.label: Deuteronomy 30:8
5716.text: “As for you, you will turn and certainly listen to the voice of Jehovah and do all his commandments that I am commanding you today.

5717.label: Deuteronomy 30:9
5717.text: And Jehovah your God will indeed make you have more than enough in every work of your hand, in the fruit of your belly and the fruit of your domestic animals and the fruitage of your soil, resulting in prosperity; because Jehovah will again exult over you for good, just as he exulted over your forefathers;

5718.label: Deuteronomy 30:10
5718.text: for you will listen to the voice of Jehovah your God so as to keep his commandments and his statutes written in this book of the law, because you will return to Jehovah your God with all your heart and all your soul.

5719.label: Deuteronomy 30:11
5719.text: “For this commandment that I am commanding you today is not too difficult for you, nor is it far away.

5720.label: Deuteronomy 30:12
5720.text: It is not in the heavens, so as to result in saying, ‘Who will ascend for us into the heavens and get it for us, that he may let us hear it that we may do it?’

5721.label: Deuteronomy 30:13
5721.text: Neither is it on the other side of the sea, so as to result in saying, ‘Who will pass over for us to the other side of the sea and get it for us, that he may let us hear it that we may do it?’

5722.label: Deuteronomy 30:14
5722.text: For the word is very near you, in your own mouth and in your own heart, that you may do it.

5723.label: Deuteronomy 30:15
5723.text: “See, I do put before you today life and good, and death and bad.

5724.label: Deuteronomy 30:16
5724.text: [If you will listen to the commandments of Jehovah your God,] which I am commanding you today, so as to love Jehovah your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judicial decisions, then you will be bound to keep alive and to multiply, and Jehovah your God must bless you in the land to which you are going to take possession of it.

5725.label: Deuteronomy 30:17
5725.text: “But if your heart turns away and you do not listen, and you are actually seduced and bow down to other gods and serve them,

5726.label: Deuteronomy 30:18
5726.text: I do tell YOU today that YOU will positively perish. YOU will not lengthen YOUR days on the ground to which you are crossing the Jordan to go to take possession of it.

5727.label: Deuteronomy 30:19
5727.text: I do take the heavens and the earth as witnesses against YOU today, that I have put life and death before you, the blessing and the malediction; and you must choose life in order that you may keep alive, you and your offspring,

5728.label: Deuteronomy 30:20
5728.text: by loving Jehovah your God, by listening to his voice and by sticking to him; for he is your life and the length of your days, that you may dwell upon the ground that Jehovah swore to your forefathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob to give to them.”

5729.label: Deuteronomy 31:1
5729.text: Then Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel

5730.label: Deuteronomy 31:2
5730.text: and said to them: “A hundred and twenty years old I am today. I shall no more be allowed to go out and come in, as Jehovah has said to me, ‘You will not cross this Jordan.’

5731.label: Deuteronomy 31:3
5731.text: Jehovah your God is the one crossing before you. He himself will annihilate these nations from before you, and you must drive them away. Joshua is the one crossing before you, just as Jehovah has spoken.

5732.label: Deuteronomy 31:4
5732.text: And Jehovah will certainly do to them just as he has done to Siʹhon and to Og, the kings of the Amʹor·ites, and to their land, when he annihilated them.

5733.label: Deuteronomy 31:5
5733.text: And Jehovah has abandoned them to YOU, and YOU must do to them according to all the commandment that I have commanded YOU.

5734.label: Deuteronomy 31:6
5734.text: BE courageous and strong. Do not be afraid or suffer a shock before them, because Jehovah your God is the one marching with you. He will neither desert you nor leave you entirely.”

5735.label: Deuteronomy 31:7
5735.text: And Moses proceeded to call Joshua and say to him before the eyes of all Israel: “Be courageous and strong, because you—you will bring this people into the land that Jehovah swore to their forefathers to give to them, and you yourself will give it to them as an inheritance.

5736.label: Deuteronomy 31:8
5736.text: And Jehovah is the one marching before you. He himself will continue with you. He will neither desert you nor leave you entirely. Do not be afraid or be terrified.”

5737.label: Deuteronomy 31:9
5737.text: Then Moses wrote this law and gave it to the priests the sons of Leʹvi, the carriers of the ark of Jehovah’s covenant, and to all the older men of Israel.

5738.label: Deuteronomy 31:10
5738.text: And Moses went on to command them, saying: “At the end of every seven years, in the appointed time of the year of the release, in the festival of booths,

5739.label: Deuteronomy 31:11
5739.text: when all Israel comes to see the face of Jehovah your God in the place that he will choose, you will read this law in front of all Israel in their hearing.

5740.label: Deuteronomy 31:12
5740.text: Congregate the people, the men and the women and the little ones and your alien resident who is within your gates, in order that they may listen and in order that they may learn, as they must fear Jehovah YOUR God and take care to carry out all the words of this law.

5741.label: Deuteronomy 31:13
5741.text: And their sons who have not known should listen, and they must learn to fear Jehovah YOUR God all the days that YOU are living upon the soil to which YOU are crossing the Jordan to take possession of it.”

5742.label: Deuteronomy 31:14
5742.text: After that Jehovah said to Moses: “Look! The days have drawn near for you to die. Call Joshua, and station yourselves in the tent of meeting, that I may commission him.” So Moses and Joshua went and stationed themselves in the tent of meeting.

5743.label: Deuteronomy 31:15
5743.text: Then Jehovah appeared at the tent in the pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud began to stand by the entrance of the tent.

5744.label: Deuteronomy 31:16
5744.text: Jehovah now said to Moses: “Look! You are lying down with your forefathers; and this people will certainly get up and have immoral intercourse with foreign gods of the land to which they are going, in their very midst, and they will certainly forsake me and break my covenant that I have concluded with them.

5745.label: Deuteronomy 31:17
5745.text: At that my anger will indeed blaze against them in that day, and I shall certainly forsake them and conceal my face from them, and they must become something to be consumed; and many calamities and distresses must come upon them, and they will be bound to say in that day, ‘Is it not because our God is not in our midst that these calamities have come upon us?’

5746.label: Deuteronomy 31:18
5746.text: As for me, I shall absolutely conceal my face in that day because of all the badness that they have done, because they have turned to other gods.

5747.label: Deuteronomy 31:19
5747.text: “And now WRITE for yourselves this song and teach it to the sons of Israel. Place it in their mouths in order that this song may serve as my witness against the sons of Israel.

5748.label: Deuteronomy 31:20
5748.text: For I shall bring them to the ground that I have sworn about to their forefathers, which flows with milk and honey, and they will certainly eat and be satisfied and grow fat and turn to other gods, and they will indeed serve them and treat me with disrespect and break my covenant.

5749.label: Deuteronomy 31:21
5749.text: And it must occur that when many calamities and distresses will come upon them, this song must also answer before them as a witness, because it should not be forgotten out of the mouth of their offspring, for I well know their inclination that they are developing today before I bring them into the land about which I have sworn.”

5750.label: Deuteronomy 31:22
5750.text: So Moses wrote this song in that day, that he might teach it to the sons of Israel.

5751.label: Deuteronomy 31:23
5751.text: And he proceeded to commission Joshua the son of Nun and to say: “Be courageous and strong, because you—you will bring the sons of Israel into the land about which I have sworn to them, and I myself shall continue with you.”

5752.label: Deuteronomy 31:24
5752.text: And it came about that as soon as Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book until their completion,

5753.label: Deuteronomy 31:25
5753.text: Moses began to command the Levites, the carriers of the ark of Jehovah’s covenant, saying:

5754.label: Deuteronomy 31:26
5754.text: “Taking this book of the law, YOU must place it at the side of the ark of the covenant of Jehovah YOUR God, and it must serve as a witness there against you.

5755.label: Deuteronomy 31:27
5755.text: For I—I well know your rebelliousness and your stiff neck. If while I am yet alive with YOU today, YOU have proved rebellious in behavior toward Jehovah, then how much more so after my death!

5756.label: Deuteronomy 31:28
5756.text: Congregate to me all the older men of YOUR tribes and YOUR officers, and let me speak in their hearing these words, and let me take the heavens and the earth as witnesses against them.

5757.label: Deuteronomy 31:29
5757.text: For I well know that after my death YOU will without fail act ruinously, and YOU will certainly turn aside from the way about which I have commanded YOU; and calamity will be bound to befall YOU at the close of the days, because YOU will do what is bad in the eyes of Jehovah so as to offend him by the works of YOUR hands.”

5758.label: Deuteronomy 31:30
5758.text: And Moses proceeded to speak in the hearing of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song until their completion:

5759.label: Deuteronomy 32:1
5759.text: “Give ear, O heavens, and let me speak;And let the earth hear the sayings of my mouth.

5760.label: Deuteronomy 32:2
5760.text: My instruction will drip as the rain, My saying will trickle as the dew, As gentle rains upon grass And as copious showers upon vegetation.

5761.label: Deuteronomy 32:3
5761.text: For I shall declare the name of Jehovah. Do YOU attribute greatness to our God!

5762.label: Deuteronomy 32:4
5762.text: The Rock, perfect is his activity, For all his ways are justice. A God of faithfulness, with whom there is no injustice; Righteous and upright is he.

5763.label: Deuteronomy 32:5
5763.text: They have acted ruinously on their own part; They are not his children, the defect is their own. A generation crooked and twisted!

5764.label: Deuteronomy 32:6
5764.text: Is it to Jehovah that YOU keep doing this way, O people stupid and not wise? Is he not your Father who has produced you, He who made you and proceeded to give you stability?

5765.label: Deuteronomy 32:7
5765.text: Remember the days of old, CONSIDER the years back from generation to generation;Ask your father, and he can tell you; Your old men, and they can say it to you.

5766.label: Deuteronomy 32:8
5766.text: When the Most High gave the nations an inheritance, When he parted the sons of Adam from one another, He proceeded to fix the boundary of the peoples With regard for the number of the sons of Israel.

5767.label: Deuteronomy 32:9
5767.text: For Jehovah’s share is his people; Jacob is the allotment that he inherits.

5768.label: Deuteronomy 32:10
5768.text: He came to find him in a wilderness land, And in an empty, howling desert. He began to encircle him, to take care of him, To safeguard him as the pupil of his eye.

5769.label: Deuteronomy 32:11
5769.text: Just as an eagle stirs up its nest,Hovers over its fledglings, Spreads out its wings, takes them,Carries them on its pinions,

5770.label: Deuteronomy 32:12
5770.text: Jehovah alone kept leading him, And there was no foreign god along with him.

5771.label: Deuteronomy 32:13
5771.text: He kept making him ride upon earth’s high places, So that he ate the produce of the field. And he kept making him suck honey out of a crag, And oil out of a flinty rock;

5772.label: Deuteronomy 32:14
5772.text: Butter of the herd and milk of the flock Together with the fat of rams,And male sheep, the breed of Baʹshan, and he-goats Together with the kidney fat of wheat; And the blood of the grape you kept drinking as wine.

5773.label: Deuteronomy 32:15
5773.text: When Jeshʹu·run began to grow fat, then he kicked. You have grown fat, you have become thick, you have become gorged. So he forsook God, who made him, And despised the Rock of his salvation.

5774.label: Deuteronomy 32:16
5774.text: They began inciting him to jealousy with strange gods; With detestable things they kept offending him.

5775.label: Deuteronomy 32:17
5775.text: They went sacrificing to demons, not to God, Gods whom they had not known, New ones who recently came in, With whom YOUR forefathers were not acquainted.

5776.label: Deuteronomy 32:18
5776.text: The Rock who fathered you, you proceeded to forget, And you began to leave God out of memory, the One bringing you forth with childbirth pains.

5777.label: Deuteronomy 32:19
5777.text: When Jehovah saw it, then he came to disrespect them, Because of the vexation his sons and his daughters gave.

5778.label: Deuteronomy 32:20
5778.text: So he said, ‘Let me conceal my face from them, Let me see what their end will be afterward.For they are a generation of perverseness, Sons in whom there is no faithfulness.

5779.label: Deuteronomy 32:21
5779.text: They, for their part, have incited me to jealousy with what is no god; They have vexed me with their vain idols; And I, for my part, shall incite them to jealousy with what is no people; With a stupid nation I shall offend them.

5780.label: Deuteronomy 32:22
5780.text: For a fire has been ignited in my anger And it will burn down to Sheʹol, the lowest place, And it will consume the earth and its produce And will set ablaze the foundations of mountains.

5781.label: Deuteronomy 32:23
5781.text: I shall increase calamities upon them; My arrows I shall spend upon them.

5782.label: Deuteronomy 32:24
5782.text: Exhausted from hunger they will be and eaten up by burning fever And bitter destruction. And the teeth of beasts I shall send upon them, With the venom of reptiles of the dust.

5783.label: Deuteronomy 32:25
5783.text: Outdoors a sword will bereave them, And indoors fright, Of both young man and virgin, Suckling together with gray-haired man.

5784.label: Deuteronomy 32:26
5784.text: I should have said: “I shall disperse them, I will make the mention of them cease from mortal men,”

5785.label: Deuteronomy 32:27
5785.text: Were it not that I was afraid of vexation from the enemy, That their adversaries might misconstrue it, That they might say: “Our hand has proved superior, And it was not Jehovah who worked all this out.”

5786.label: Deuteronomy 32:28
5786.text: For they are a nation on whom counsel perishes, And among them there is no understanding.

5787.label: Deuteronomy 32:29
5787.text: O that they were wise! Then they would ponder over this. They would consider their end afterward.

5788.label: Deuteronomy 32:30
5788.text: How could one pursue a thousand,And two put ten thousand to flight? Not unless their Rock had sold them And Jehovah had surrendered them.

5789.label: Deuteronomy 32:31
5789.text: For their rock is not like our Rock, Even our enemies being the ones to decide.

5790.label: Deuteronomy 32:32
5790.text: For their vine is from the vine of SodʹomAnd from the terraces of Go·morʹrah. Their grapes are grapes of poison,Their clusters are bitter.

5791.label: Deuteronomy 32:33
5791.text: Their wine is the venom of big snakesAnd the cruel poison of cobras.

5792.label: Deuteronomy 32:34
5792.text: Is it not laid up with me,With a seal affixed to it in my storehouse?

5793.label: Deuteronomy 32:35
5793.text: Vengeance is mine, and retribution. At the appointed time their foot will move unsteadily, For the day of their disaster is near, And the events in readiness for them do make haste.’

5794.label: Deuteronomy 32:36
5794.text: For Jehovah will judge his people And he will feel regret over his servants, Because he will see that support has disappearedAnd there is only a helpless and worthless one.

5795.label: Deuteronomy 32:37
5795.text: And he will certainly say, ‘Where are their gods, The rock in whom they sought refuge,

5796.label: Deuteronomy 32:38
5796.text: Who used to eat the fat of their sacrifices, To drink the wine of their drink offerings? Let them get up and help YOU. Let them become a concealment place for YOU.

5797.label: Deuteronomy 32:39
5797.text: SEE now that I—I am he And there are no gods together with me. I put to death, and I make alive. I have severely wounded, and I—I will heal, And there is no one snatching out of my hand.

5798.label: Deuteronomy 32:40
5798.text: For I raise my hand to heaven [in an oath], And I do say: “As I am alive to time indefinite,”

5799.label: Deuteronomy 32:41
5799.text: If I do indeed sharpen my glittering sword, And my hand takes hold on judgment, I will pay back vengeance to my adversaries And render retribution to those who intensely hate me.

5800.label: Deuteronomy 32:42
5800.text: I shall intoxicate my arrows with blood, While my sword will eat flesh, With the blood of the slain and the captives, With the heads of the leaders of the enemy.’

5801.label: Deuteronomy 32:43
5801.text: Be glad, YOU nations, with his people, For he will avenge the blood of his servants, And he will pay back vengeance to his adversaries And will indeed make atonement for the ground of his people.”

5802.label: Deuteronomy 32:44
5802.text: Thus Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he and Ho·sheʹa the son of Nun.

5803.label: Deuteronomy 32:45
5803.text: After Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel,

5804.label: Deuteronomy 32:46
5804.text: he went on to say to them: “Apply YOUR hearts to all the words that I am speaking in warning to YOU today, that YOU may command YOUR sons to take care to do all the words of this law.

5805.label: Deuteronomy 32:47
5805.text: For it is no valueless word for YOU, but it means YOUR life, and by this word YOU may lengthen YOUR days upon the soil to which YOU are crossing the Jordan to take possession of it.”

5806.label: Deuteronomy 32:48
5806.text: And Jehovah proceeded to speak to Moses on this same day, saying:

5807.label: Deuteronomy 32:49
5807.text: “Go up into this mountain of Abʹa·rim, Mount Neʹbo, which is in the land of Moʹab, which fronts toward Jerʹi·cho, and see the land of Caʹnaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel as a possession.

5808.label: Deuteronomy 32:50
5808.text: Then die on the mountain into which you are going up, and be gathered to your people, just as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor and got to be gathered to his people;

5809.label: Deuteronomy 32:51
5809.text: for the reason that YOU men acted undutifully toward me in the middle of the sons of Israel at the waters of Merʹi·bah of Kaʹdesh in the wilderness of Zin; for the reason that YOU men did not sanctify me in the middle of the sons of Israel.

5810.label: Deuteronomy 32:52
5810.text: For from a distance you will see the land, but you will not go there into the land that I am giving to the sons of Israel.”

5811.label: Deuteronomy 33:1
5811.text: Now this is the blessing with which Moses the man of the [true] God blessed the sons of Israel before his death.

5812.label: Deuteronomy 33:2
5812.text: And he proceeded to say: “Jehovah—from Siʹnai he came, And he flashed forth from Seʹir upon them. He beamed forth from the mountainous region of Paʹran, And with him were holy myriads, At his right hand warriors belonging to them.

5813.label: Deuteronomy 33:3
5813.text: He was also cherishing his people; All their holy ones are in your hand. And they—they reclined at your feet; They began to receive some of your words.

5814.label: Deuteronomy 33:4
5814.text: (Moses laid as a command upon us a law, A possession of the congregation of Jacob.)

5815.label: Deuteronomy 33:5
5815.text: And he came to be king in Jeshʹu·run, When the heads of the people gathered themselves, The entire number of the tribes of Israel.

5816.label: Deuteronomy 33:6
5816.text: Let Reuʹben live and not die off, And let his men [not] become few.”

5817.label: Deuteronomy 33:7
5817.text: And this was Judah’s [blessing], as he went on to say: “Hear, O Jehovah, the voice of Judah, And may you bring him to his people.His arms have contended for what is his; And may you prove yourself a helper from his adversaries.”

5818.label: Deuteronomy 33:8
5818.text: And as to Leʹvi he said: “Your Thumʹmim and your Uʹrim belong to the man loyal to you, Whom you put to the test at Masʹsah. You began to contend with him by the waters of Merʹi·bah,

5819.label: Deuteronomy 33:9
5819.text: The man who said to his father and his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’Even his brothers he did not acknowledge, And his sons he did not know.For they kept your saying, And your covenant they continued to observe.

5820.label: Deuteronomy 33:10
5820.text: Let them instruct Jacob in your judicial decisions And Israel in your law. Let them render up incense before your nostrils And a whole offering on your altar.

5821.label: Deuteronomy 33:11
5821.text: Bless, O Jehovah, his vital energy, And may you show pleasure in the activity of his hands. Wound severely in their hips those who rise up against him, And those who intensely hate him, that they may not rise up.”

5822.label: Deuteronomy 33:12
5822.text: As to Benjamin he said: “Let the beloved one of Jehovah reside in security by him, While he shelters him the whole day, And he must reside between his shoulders.”

5823.label: Deuteronomy 33:13
5823.text: And as to Joseph he said: “May his land be continually blessed from Jehovah With the choice things of heaven, with dew, And with the watery deep lying down below,

5824.label: Deuteronomy 33:14
5824.text: And with the choice things, the products of the sun, And with the choice things, the yield of the lunar months,

5825.label: Deuteronomy 33:15
5825.text: And with the choicest from the mountains of the east, And with the choice things of the indefinitely lasting hills,

5826.label: Deuteronomy 33:16
5826.text: And with the choice things of the earth and its fullness, And with the approval of the One residing in the thornbush. May they come upon the head of Joseph And upon the crown of the head of the one singled out from his brothers.

5827.label: Deuteronomy 33:17
5827.text: As the firstborn of a bull his splendor is, And his horns are the horns of a wild bull. With them he will push peoples All together to the ends of the earth,And they are the tens of thousands of Eʹphra·im, And they are the thousands of Ma·nasʹseh.”

5828.label: Deuteronomy 33:18
5828.text: And as to Zebʹu·lun he said: “Rejoice, O Zebʹu·lun, in your going out, And, Isʹsa·char, in your tents.

5829.label: Deuteronomy 33:19
5829.text: Peoples to the mountain they will call.There they will sacrifice the sacrifices of righteousness. For they will suck the abounding wealth of the seas And the hidden hoards of the sand.”

5830.label: Deuteronomy 33:20
5830.text: And as to Gad he said: “Blessed is the one widening the borders of Gad. As a lion he must reside, And he must tear the arm, yes, the crown of the head.

5831.label: Deuteronomy 33:21
5831.text: And he will pick out the first part for himself, For there the allotment of a statute-giver is reserved. And the heads of the people will gather themselves together. The righteousness of Jehovah will he certainly executeAnd his judicial decisions with Israel.”

5832.label: Deuteronomy 33:22
5832.text: And as to Dan he said: “Dan is a lion cub. He will leap out from Baʹshan.”

5833.label: Deuteronomy 33:23
5833.text: And as to Naphʹta·li he said: “Naphʹta·li is satisfied with the approvalAnd full of the blessing of Jehovah.Do take possession of the west and south.”

5834.label: Deuteronomy 33:24
5834.text: And as to Ashʹer he said: “Blessed with sons is Ashʹer. Let him become one approved by his brothers, And one dipping his foot in oil.

5835.label: Deuteronomy 33:25
5835.text: Iron and copper are your gate locks, And in proportion to your days is your leisurely walk.

5836.label: Deuteronomy 33:26
5836.text: There is none like the [true] God of Jeshʹu·run, Who rides upon heaven in help of you And upon cloudy skies in his eminence.

5837.label: Deuteronomy 33:27
5837.text: A hiding place is the God of ancient time, And underneath are the indefinitely lasting arms. And he will drive away from before you the enemy, And he will say, ‘Annihilate [them]!’

5838.label: Deuteronomy 33:28
5838.text: And Israel will reside in security, The fountain of Jacob by itself, Upon a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens will let the dew drip down.

5839.label: Deuteronomy 33:29
5839.text: Happy you are, O Israel! Who is there like you, A people enjoying salvation in Jehovah, The shield of your help, And the One who is your eminent sword? So your enemies will cringe before you, And you—upon their high places you will tread.”

5840.label: Deuteronomy 34:1
5840.text: Then Moses proceeded to go up from the desert plains of Moʹab into Mount Neʹbo, to the top of Pisʹgah, which fronts toward Jerʹi·cho. And Jehovah went showing him all the land, Gilʹe·ad as far as Dan,

5841.label: Deuteronomy 34:2
5841.text: and all Naphʹta·li and the land of Eʹphra·im and Ma·nasʹseh and all the land of Judah as far as the western sea,

5842.label: Deuteronomy 34:3
5842.text: and the Negʹeb and the District, the valley plain of Jerʹi·cho, the city of the palm trees, as far as Zoʹar.

5843.label: Deuteronomy 34:4
5843.text: And Jehovah went on to say to him: “This is the land about which I have sworn to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, ‘To your seed I shall give it.’ I have caused you to see it with your own eyes, as you will not cross over there.”

5844.label: Deuteronomy 34:5
5844.text: After that Moses the servant of Jehovah died there in the land of Moʹab at the order of Jehovah.

5845.label: Deuteronomy 34:6
5845.text: And he proceeded to bury him in the valley in the land of Moʹab in front of Beth-peʹor, and nobody has come to know his grave down to this day.

5846.label: Deuteronomy 34:7
5846.text: And Moses was a hundred and twenty years old at his death. His eye had not grown dim, and his vital strength had not fled.

5847.label: Deuteronomy 34:8
5847.text: And the sons of Israel proceeded to weep for Moses on the desert plains of Moʹab thirty days. At length the days of weeping of the mourning period for Moses were completed.

5848.label: Deuteronomy 34:9
5848.text: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hand upon him; and the sons of Israel began to listen to him and they went doing just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.

5849.label: Deuteronomy 34:10
5849.text: But there has never yet risen up a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Jehovah knew face to face,

5850.label: Deuteronomy 34:11
5850.text: as respects all the signs and the miracles that Jehovah sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharʹaoh and all his servants and all his land,

5851.label: Deuteronomy 34:12
5851.text: and as regards all the strong hand and all the great awesomeness that Moses exercised before the eyes of all Israel.
